Why is this election important? Wisconsin's Supreme Court elections are nonpartisan, but the ideological balance of the court has widespread ramifications for voting rights, civil rights, and a slew of other state policy implications. State Supreme Courts like this one are also often the final arbiters of election disputes, as we saw in both the 2020 and 2022 elections.
In 2023 progressive judge Janet Protasiewicz won a similar race and flipped the balance of the Wisconsin Supreme Court, giving the state a 4-3 pro-voting rights majority. The outcome of this year's election will determine whether Wisconsin holds that liberal majority moving forward or if the court slides back to the suppressive policies of Wisconsin's past.

I get asked all the time why I initially ran for Congress.

“Congress is a mess! Why would you want to go there?” I get it. It’s a fair question.

I wanted to reach out, personally, to explain exactly why I ran for Congress in the first place and why I’m running for re-election now. [**If you don’t have time to read the rest of my note (that’s okay!), can I count on you to pitch in a few dollars to our grassroots campaign?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104385923/535212165/476240477?amount=3&refcode=em_fr_2025.03.23_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDkzZDRiMDYtNDkwOC1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q0YcZtVr8-XstVkafJSo-ivSGxNBr8RekHvJTCKjA6s=)

**I ran for Congress because, like many of you, I want my children to inherit a better world than the one I grew up in.**

You see, my mom first encouraged me to run for office saying "If your generation doesn't stand up and fight, we stand to lose the progress my generation worked for." She was right. It’s on us to ensure the next generation has access to quality education, affordable housing, and good-paying jobs.

**I ran for Congress because I believe all hardworking American families deserve the opportunity to get ahead.**

I grew up in a working-class family. Both of my parents were teachers and there were times when it felt impossible to get ahead. I know a lot of families today can relate.

**I ran for Congress because the American people deserve a House Majority dedicated to placing people over politics.**

House Republicans have turned their back on this community to support Donald Trump and Elon Musk's dangerous power grabs. We need leaders in the Majority who will stand up to far-right extremists, and deliver meaningful change for families across Oregon.

**With Donald Trump and Elon Musk undermining our nation’s very foundation every day, our fight is far from over. The work continues every day. That’s why I’m running for re-election.**

[**Will you make a donation to my re-election campaign today to help me fight for a better world, expand opportunity for all, and ensure Democrats can take back the House Majority from MAGA Republicans next year?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104385924/535212172/476240477?amount=3&refcode=em_fr_2025.03.23_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDkzZDRiMDYtNDkwOC1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q0YcZtVr8-XstVkafJSo-ivSGxNBr8RekHvJTCKjA6s=)

And to that, I say **absolutely.** Peter, my name is Winsome Earle-Sears. I don't often make promises, but I can promise you this: I'm not your typical politician, **and I 'm not like the others who normally send you these messages:**-I immigrated to the US from Jamaica with my family when I was six years old.
-I served in the Marine Corps as an electrician.
-I ran a women's homeless shelter and a men's prison ministry.I've lived a full, rewarding life - and I owe it all to this country. In a world of so much uncertainty, I know one thing to be 100% true: _**my story is only possible in America.**_ And now, I'm running for Governor of Virginia - to make certain that the same country that let a poor, black woman ascend to the highest levels of politics remains that way - a beacon of hope.

_But the reality we have to confront is that those on the Left are actively trying to tear this down. SB25-003, the $27 million paywall on the Second Amendment
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-C1gw/seic1451037)
---
**March 23, 2025** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,

This week, the Colorado legislature moved one step closer to passing one of the most egregious attacks on our constitutional rights in recent memory. [SB25-003](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-C1gw/s6kaf8a8ad4), a bill that amounts to a [$27 million paywall on the Second Amendment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-C1gw/selef614193), passed its second reading in the House late Thursday night—despite powerful resistance from House Republicans and gun rights advocates across the state.

This bill would create a tangled web of **government fees, fingerprinting, in-person training requirements, and state-run registries** —all designed to make it harder for law-abiding citizens to exercise their right to self-defense. It unfairly burdens rural sheriffs, working-class Coloradans, and even veterans, while doing nothing to actually stop crime.

As Rep. Lisa Frizell said, “Let’s be honest about what this is—it’s a poll tax on the Second Amendment.” And she’s right. This isn’t about safety—it’s about control.

Beyond the individual cost, the fiscal note is alarming: **over $1.4 million to launch, $500,000 per year to maintain, and up to $27 million in lost federal wildlife funds.** That’s money stripped from our communities to enforce an unconstitutional law that punishes responsible gun owners.

Our Republican lawmakers fought hard, and [they’re not done yet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-C1gw/s5v720c0b5a). With the bill moving to its third and final reading, activists are urging Coloradans in swing districts to call their Democrat legislators. Stay tuned for more updates as this bill heads toward its final vote.

In liberty and truth,
Heidi

Dear Peter,

This is Scott Kaspar here, General Counsel of the Illinois Review. This is a tough piece to write. For the past two years, Illinois Review has been exposing the fraud within our state party to help conservatives understand why we don't win races in Illinois. So much of those lost elections keep coming down not to Democrat voters, but to the malicious actions of our own state party leadership. Below is yet another example.

The state party's policy on mailers is that the IL GOP does not oppose Republican incumbents. Well, here is a story where the IL GOP is meddling with a Republican incumbent – a Trump Delegate, to be clear – in of all races but a nonpartisan fire district race, literally the election at the bottom of the ballot.

If you're running for State Representative or State Senate, good luck to you, because your state party is focused on hyper local nonpartisan fire district races this cycle.

Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
http://www.twitter.com/illinoisreview?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823 Twitter (http://www.twitter.com/illinoisreview?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)

IL GOP Funds Mailer Opposing Trump Delegate as State Party Remains Target in Federal Postal Service Investigation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
(Photo collage by Illinois Review)
By Illinois Review

A new mailer bearing the Illinois Republican Party’s postage permit surfaced this weekend in a race supporting preferred candidates against the Trump Delegate incumbent, signaling that the IL GOP has resumed its postage discount scheme – a practice that has kept the state party a target in an ongoing federal post office investigation.

As President Ronald Reagan famously stated, “There you go again.”

Two years ago, this publication revealed that the Illinois Republican Party had
weaponized (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-weaponized-postage-discount-to-attack-conservative-candidates-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) its postage discount to attack conservative Republican candidates during the Spring 2022 primary. Initially the IL GOP denied allowing preferred candidates to use its postage discount, until IR obtained exclusive audio (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/exclusive-audio-don-tracy-admits-irvin-campaign-used-il-gop-postage-discount-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) from then Chairman Don Tracy admitting to the scheme.

The practice continued again in
Will County (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/will-county-gop-establishment-tries-to-discredit-concerns-over-mailers-but-theyre-creating-more-questions-than-answers-instead.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) races in Spring 2023. The scandal ultimately led to former Will County GOP Chair Tim Ozinga’s resignation.

Sources have confirmed to IR that the matter had been referred to the Inspector General of the United States Postal Service, who still may be conducting an independent investigation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/sources-senior-us-post-office-officials-probing-potential-il-gop-postage-discount-abuse-reaches-the-inspector-generals-office-in-washington.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .

Despite assurances from former IL GOP Chair Don Tracy that the party would stay “strictly neutral (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-attacks-illinois-review-over-postage-discount-says-gop-strictly-neutral-during-governor-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) ” in contested races between Republican candidates, it appears the IL GOP is back in the game of allowing its preferred candidates to use its postage discount in contested elections against other Republicans.

This past weekend, Republican voters in Chicago suburb Orland Park, Illinois, received a mailer indicating that it was “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” supporting three candidates for a nonpartisan fire district race.

The incumbent who these IL GOP-endorsed candidates are trying to oust?

Trump Delegate and GOP donor Beth Damas Kaspar (https://fiscalvoicesfororlandfire.com/beth-damas-kaspar/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
A mailer indicating that it is “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” endorsing certain preferred candidates against Republican incumbent Beth Damas of Orland Park, Illinois. (Source: Illinois Review)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
The mailer includes several allegations about the fire district’s finances, including one claim that the fire district allegedly overpaid for insurance in order to benefit former Cook County Commissioner and Orland Township Republican Committeewoman Liz Gorman.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
45th and 47th President Donald J. Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas).
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Lara Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)

Beth Damas Kaspar, who spoke with IR, found the IL GOP’s involvement in this local nonpartisan race against her, a lifelong Republican, to be “completely disgusting.” She stated,

“The statements on this mailer are completely false and bear no resemblance to reality. I am proud that under my watch, the Orland Fire Protection District’s finances have never been stronger. We shifted the insurance contract away from an agency associated with Michael Madigan’s family to an independent agency, providing better coverage and saving the fire district nearly a million dollars annually. This was a board decision following a regular bid process, and the notion that Liz Gorman somehow benefits from this is unfounded.”

Liz Gorman served as the 17th district Commissioner on the Cook County board as a Republican for thirteen years. In 2018, Gov. Bruce Rauner appointed (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2018/02/22/former-cook-county-commissioner-liz-gorman-of-orland-park-hired-to-head-illinois-tollway/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) her as the Executive Director of the Illinois Tollway. She continues to serve on the board (https://www.rtachicago.org/about-rta/press-releases/rta-announces-new-board-member-liz-gorman?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of the Regional Transportation Authority.

Following Gorman’s departure from the Cook County Board, IL GOP State Central Committeeman Sean Morrison was appointed to fill her seat. Morrison narrowly survived a Democrat challenge for the seat in 2017, after allegations surfaced that Morrison
penned a letter (https://chicago.suntimes.com/2018/6/18/18367224/county-pol-defends-vouching-for-employee-charged-in-child-sex-case?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) to a Cook County judge seeking permission for one of Morrison’s senior vice presidents to continue to travel on business while the employee was facing criminal charges for solicitation to meet a child. Nineteen days after the letter was submitted, Morrison’s employee was arrested in Colorado on charges of trying to sexually exploit a child using the Internet.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Cook County Commissioner Sean Morrison. (Source: Nancy Stone/Chicago Tribune)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
Morrison served as co-chair (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=0000017e-6d5c-dbc8-a1ff-7d7dbf990000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of the failed Richard Irvin for Governor campaign in 2022, where Irvin lost to former State Senator Darren Bailey by 43 points (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/opinion-how-the-il-gop-has-turned-gov-ron-desantis-into-their-own-version-of-the-richard-irvin-campaign-for-governor.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) . During the primary campaign, it was reported by WTTW’s Paris Schutz (https://news.wttw.com/2022/05/13/gop-gubernatorial-candidate-richard-irvin-called-donald-trump-idiot-bigoted-racist-text?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) that in 2018, Irvin sent text messages calling Trump an “idiot” and a “bigoted racist.” Irvin also texted the friend, “I hate Trump too!”

In 2022, Gorman unsuccessfully challenged Morrison for her former Commissioner seat. Disclosures
reveal (https://www.illinoissunshine.org/committees/22433/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) that Morrison spent more than $180,000 to fend off the challenge.

Last year, Morrison joined the Democrats and voted in favor of reallocating
$70M (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/04/18/cook-county-reallocates-70m-for-migrants-from-health-care-to-food-service-in-chicago/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of county funds to provide health care and food service for illegal aliens in Chicago. With Morrison's vote in favor, the reallocation was unanimous, joining the sixteen other Democrats on the Cook County Board.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Migrants are led from one bus to another after arriving at Chicago’s Union Station on Sept. 9, 2022. (Source: Chris Sweda/Chicago Tribune via Getty Images file)
Beth Damas Kaspar is running for re-election to the Board of Trustees of Orland Fire Protection District. Her slate, Fiscal Voices for Fire Safety (https://fiscalvoicesfororlandfire.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=963f182ff9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) , includes Republicans Donald "DJ" Jeffers and Bridget Eileen Tolan.

The election is April 1, 2025.

This is a tough piece to write. For the past two years, Illinois Review has been exposing the fraud within our state party to help conservatives understand why we don't win races in Illinois. So much of those lost elections keep coming down not to Democrat voters, but to the malicious actions of our own state party leadership. Below is yet another example. The state party's policy on mailers is that the IL GOP does not oppose Republican incumbents. Well, here is a story where the IL GOP is meddling with a Republican incumbent – a Trump Delegate, to be clear – in of all races but a nonpartisan fire district race, literally the election at the bottom of the ballot. If you're running for State Representative or State Senate, good luck to you, because your state party is focused on hyper local nonpartisan fire district races this cycle. Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump. Twitter () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () IL GOP Funds Mailer Opposing Trump Delegate as State Party Remains Target in Federal Postal Service Investigation () (Photo collage by Illinois Review) By Illinois Review A new mailer bearing the Illinois Republican Party’s postage permit surfaced this weekend in a race supporting preferred candidates against the Trump Delegate incumbent, signaling that the IL GOP has resumed its postage discount scheme – a practice that has kept the state party a target in an ongoing federal post office investigation. As President Ronald Reagan famously stated, “There you go again.” Two years ago, this publication revealed that the Illinois Republican Party had weaponized () its postage discount to attack conservative Republican candidates during the Spring 2022 primary. Initially the IL GOP denied allowing preferred candidates to use its postage discount, until IR obtained exclusive audio () from then Chairman Don Tracy admitting to the scheme. The practice continued again in Will County () races in Spring 2023. The scandal ultimately led to former Will County GOP Chair Tim Ozinga’s resignation. Sources have confirmed to IR that the matter had been referred to the Inspector General of the United States Postal Service, who still may be conducting an independent investigation () . Despite assurances from former IL GOP Chair Don Tracy that the party would stay “strictly neutral () ” in contested races between Republican candidates, it appears the IL GOP is back in the game of allowing its preferred candidates to use its postage discount in contested elections against other Republicans. This past weekend, Republican voters in Chicago suburb Orland Park, Illinois, received a mailer indicating that it was “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” supporting three candidates for a nonpartisan fire district race. The incumbent who these IL GOP-endorsed candidates are trying to oust? Trump Delegate and GOP donor Beth Damas Kaspar () . A mailer indicating that it is “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” endorsing certain preferred candidates against Republican incumbent Beth Damas of Orland Park, Illinois. (Source: Illinois Review) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The mailer includes several allegations about the fire district’s finances, including one claim that the fire district allegedly overpaid for insurance in order to benefit former Cook County Commissioner and Orland Township Republican Committeewoman Liz Gorman. 45th and 47th President Donald J. Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas). Lara Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Beth Damas Kaspar, who spoke with IR, found the IL GOP’s involvement in this local nonpartisan race against her, a lifelong Republican, to be “completely disgusting.” She stated, “The statements on this mailer are completely false and bear no resemblance to reality. I am proud that under my watch, the Orland Fire Protection District’s finances have never been stronger. We shifted the insurance contract away from an agency associated with Michael Madigan’s family to an independent agency, providing better coverage and saving the fire district nearly a million dollars annually. This was a board decision following a regular bid process, and the notion that Liz Gorman somehow benefits from this is unfounded.” Liz Gorman served as the 17th district Commissioner on the Cook County board as a Republican for thirteen years. In 2018, Gov. Bruce Rauner appointed () her as the Executive Director of the Illinois Tollway. She continues to serve on the board () of the Regional Transportation Authority. Following Gorman’s departure from the Cook County Board, IL GOP State Central Committeeman Sean Morrison was appointed to fill her seat. Morrison narrowly survived a Democrat challenge for the seat in 2017, after allegations surfaced that Morrison penned a letter () to a Cook County judge seeking permission for one of Morrison’s senior vice presidents to continue to travel on business while the employee was facing criminal charges for solicitation to meet a child. Nineteen days after the letter was submitted, Morrison’s employee was arrested in Colorado on charges of trying to sexually exploit a child using the Internet. Cook County Commissioner Sean Morrison. (Source: Nancy Stone/Chicago Tribune) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Morrison served as co-chair () of the failed Richard Irvin for Governor campaign in 2022, where Irvin lost to former State Senator Darren Bailey by 43 points () . During the primary campaign, it was reported by WTTW’s Paris Schutz () that in 2018, Irvin sent text messages calling Trump an “idiot” and a “bigoted racist.” Irvin also texted the friend, “I hate Trump too!” In 2022, Gorman unsuccessfully challenged Morrison for her former Commissioner seat. Disclosures reveal () that Morrison spent more than $180,000 to fend off the challenge. Last year, Morrison joined the Democrats and voted in favor of reallocating $70M () of county funds to provide health care and food service for illegal aliens in Chicago. With Morrison's vote in favor, the reallocation was unanimous, joining the sixteen other Democrats on the Cook County Board. Migrants are led from one bus to another after arriving at Chicago’s Union Station on Sept. 9, 2022. (Source: Chris Sweda/Chicago Tribune via Getty Images file) Beth Damas Kaspar is running for re-election to the Board of Trustees of Orland Fire Protection District. | | | | | We’re back with one of the [most powerful and important episodes of the No Doubt About It Podcast to date](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ca7d7d9498&e=567664f14c). This week, we break down the tragic and shocking Las Cruces car show shooting, the growing crime epidemic in New Mexico, and the failure of our political leadership to do anything about it.
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c754cb4aad&e=567664f14c)
|
# What You’ll Hear in This Episode:
---
| **🚨 Breaking News: Las Cruces Car Show Turns Deadly:**
Three people killed and 15 injured in a mass shooting at a car show in Las Cruces, NM. Social media was quick to jump to conclusions, with images of a man holding an AR-15 going viral. Turns out—he wasn’t the shooter. In reality, this was two rival groups with handguns, opening fire and hitting innocent bystanders.
**🔥 Mark Breaks Down the Bigger Picture:**
This tragedy is just one more example of what happens when a state becomes soft on crime. Mark explains how New Mexico has created an environment where young criminals feel empowered—with zero respect for the rule of law. Even the Las Cruces Police Chief admitted: _**“There is no respect for law in this state.”**_
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3623c4e246&e=567664f14c)
---
| **🎙️ Special Guest, Paul Gessing, Founder of the Rio Grande Foundation:**
Paul joins Mark and Krysty to break down how the far-left legislature refuses to hold criminals accountable. They also discuss how the recent legislative session failed to address crime, while proposing more tax increases—despite record surpluses. Paul also shares his ongoing push to eliminate the state income tax, a policy that could lift the burden on working families across New Mexico.
**🤯 Minnesota Governor Celebrates Tesla's Fall... At His Own State’s Expense?:**
Governor Tim Walz cheers the decline of Tesla stock, even though Minnesota’s retirement plan is heavily invested in the EV company. We ask: Why is a sitting governor rooting for the collapse of his own citizens’ retirement savings?
**🏀 Go Lobos! New Mexico Wins Round 1:**
We wrap the episode with a celebration of the New Mexico Lobos' victory in Round 1 of the NCAA tournament! Plus, a preview of their big Round 2 matchup with Michigan State—let’s go Lobos!
---

## Canada Announces Snap Election
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Sunday [called a snap election for April 28](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1v8yAURn8N3rDggj8yMOR9JW-punW0MFySW2GwDImVf1-5e6dneKSjo_N1m2-WIqX7h13R1JBnENBxoTjo2VuK71k33gREQNWgkYOGUYphEM3DjE4ubgnaB3FRKgQQixuVh-DU0PcyNGROmlCgpRCdUm3fabeMF9k5j12vLNMCPdW8t9-ZUn1giO_8wr11eW2iedS6FaauDCYG03Ec7VrS-TGYMPFnYTAlPM458h49g6kku3GM6CrlxDeqhTubrLfc3i2lUnndn-vGYLI7v17lv-fn_6XZjd8OipFKPzAt7qul-OtQ_2ryMvATAAD__4gdZCg), just nine days after taking office, citing the need to address Canada’s ongoing trade tensions with the United States. Carney has [described the situation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O4yAQRZ8GdxPBAP4pKLZxl223tMZ4HLPBYGGSyG-_yvZffXWPjs6f-3SnEEN6_KadXV3zhBItSA1opoVCvCbTLG5lRtYNO9UZ7JXsOtlsTtl5tjRr1fezVG3Xa2PlYGarZNeqQTXBfWlSo1FSWq1vrTV-7gdl_cK21SSM5CXUXG5_c0h14zVe-c3l5vPeRLfVepxC_xI4ChzrxluI8bsJHI8cg78EjiFVLolqyImiwNGiHHqtwVOiheDYYafyBE8l8QWeYjxhzQXORAdwZP99wknXCbW89gM-OVWYC9MTXqfAsSluOT4hxnC2nTDysVP4b9HUn4q9Hf4LAAD__4aObbs) as the "most significant crisis of our lifetimes," as recent U.S. tariff proposals raise concerns about cross-border trade. His main challenger, Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre, is running on a platform of Canadian self-reliance. Other contenders include Jagmeet Singh of the left-leaning New Democratic Party. [Polls currently show](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL_O3CAQxJ8Gd1jLgv98BUUaukub0tozyx0JBguTs_z2kdN_zWiKn2ZG8-uxPCimmF8_aWPbQlkQcJCgJZrFU0zXYjpvAzOy7tiqyeCsYJqge1uFE0GAQMSgwqiGZ_DPAKOeFJpg5i7aOw00GgUwaN2Pg1mf85caVs_DqEkYYB9bqf3vEnN7c0hX-XDt17J1yb5b2w-hfwh0At15nv3fg1rxdN2AQHe0Ui-BLvN53ESpyQt0d6tAB_r2t6yUyZPca9xYbjHHo3GVG9U_cqWa-ZJHpl1y4rXFkgW6GUc0X8MIMAl0XbV-P2NK8RgnYeC1UUz_R7bvTvtY_BcAAP__0eBsFQ) the Liberals leading the Conservatives 42% to 37%.
## Americans Snack Less As Prices Soar
Americans are [snacking less](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGTuyAQBfBPgx0OLqhJQZF_YZd_e6WzwqpcEHJA4vjtb0x_9W9n35v3dR_v6LwLy3_cSJc5jiCg5UJyUKNF549RVVbPRECyIt30Ci6N6HtRrdp0s2pENzWARkErr6BITBb7DpUAmiunz29CgmqEaKWsu1aZ6XJtWmOp7SQyJci6ElP9HV0oK83-iG9KtYlb5fVayjMzeWMwMBj2fa-3HE5jMFDgr8xgmGO0HIPlNrnwYDCshL6sBzcxPlxYPkZYXFgYDGUlngOajyQylLOLge_rwXGj5AyGzDERn17HeTLTTomXRFjOMEz8dmv-LWb7qZK2z91573LXMyWWDZ3_9C5_7fjW8BsAAP__CW93Vg), according to packaged food giants like General Mills, J.M. Smucker Co., and Campbell Soup Company, all of which reported sales declines of 3% to 7% in the most recent quarter. Executives attribute the slowdown to [inflation and high prices](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvhCAUwPFPAxsXeCB6A0MXt-va0YA89LUoRug1fvvmunf-J7_k__GYHp4y7cu739C1VCaQ0AmpBZgpesrXZHh0CRFQc3SqNzAo2feSr85rG2w0Ktk0qAApQAgKLd51UjEpxcm9NKnBKCk7rW-2M3MY7qqbI3ZWe2YkRmrlvH0W2tuKKV_liedtLhvPbm3tqEy_MRgZjFvZ8XoVBmPd_fwlqs9YRc3f2yFWWlZxnDRjZTDy08Xjh3Kmantm5LJ5yn9q--_y6eA3AAD__7Z7VHo), as consumers pull back from sweet and salty snacks that have seen average price increases of 22% since 2020. Analysts say that while weight-loss drugs like Ozempic may play a small role in the decline, they suggest that product changes and price cuts may be on the horizon.
## Fire Breaks Out at Disney World
A [fire broke out](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAQBeBfgzcsOMB2BoYu3tK1o4XhiGmwiYAE5d9Xrrp2-3QnPT29r-tyNSGG4_ZpdtTVpwUYKMoEBbk4E-J7kZ3THhFQdKj5KGHibBxZt-nJWpg4584zycfVc8XMarx0irPBrqYL-kxjAiRnTAnRD0radbpwZR2qQRgiGbpQU-6_Uzjqhj6-0wtzb9PeRb3V-ihEfBCYCcyttf5Y7YGtnH8C80kC87PQP5U93ZE-4nNH6kI58E1bytHRZgq15lnwZLxTm1LEfJ5uW6U-ZKTZHoZfxmGYuqzdo4UYQxlGItltNyH-Vqr_TfTS8BMAAP__4b1qPw) Saturday at Walt Disney World Resort in Orlando, Florida, sending a plume of smoke over a theme park busy with spring breakers. Park officials confirmed that a walk-in cooler caught fire backstage at the France Pavilion, but the cause of the blaze is not yet known. Emergency responders quickly extinguished the fire, and the pavilion reopened later in the evening. ## George Foreman Dies at 76
Boxing legend, successful entrepreneur, and Houston resident [George Foreman passed away](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0ULuSrCAU_BrMtOAAPgKCm5DNTTe0DnJUqnCYAnYc_37LzTfqDvpV_fWYHxhieG7_8SBTP2uagYNuuWxBzR5DvGbVeOO4n0RDRgwKRqG4Es1u5CSFX9w6DWM_IEny2ouFpHLoF-dcE8wdxiUowfWgdDc61AvqHoimEXpkipMPNeWu7lTpg2WNV3pT7pZ0NNHstb4Kk_8YWAb2PM_uu2BNHq9bwMCWmvJ14yvlWhhYlz7huTGwdzMDy-XNxe3eU3tiaTdKeaN2TZkOfDKwI_Rcaxg4HxjYJhv_OkOMofQDU3w7MMTfOfXPf94GfgIAAP__THplug) Friday at the age of 76, according to a social media post from his family. Born in Marshall, Texas, Foreman won the gold medal in boxing at the 1968 Olympics in Mexico City and defeated Joe Frazier for the world heavyweight title in 1973. The following year, he lost to Muhammad Ali in the famed “Rumble in the Jungle” in Zaire, but he reclaimed his title in 1994 after an extended absence from the sport, becoming the [oldest ever to achieve the feat](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1iwBhsKimvocu2VFg5rvBKGyObi5O1PydV_N9JoRp--P7f5FihTSb_Djq691jqDAM3FwEHNMVB-z6qLbhHRyg6dnBQYqYSS3easnSQGPcVBjlobK9AYZVbUwq42guzIfc7EAEoKPSndmyXoe9AjIFoDY2BKYKRWj75t2PAVzjW_6xOP_l73LruttcfJhl8MPAN_XVeP56N8SgZ-qS8qiYE_Wz3eDPzMwFNk4JUatLHDxMAnrEdCvtYD91D4gqHxVKkk_n_Ot787ZQqNauFPKpHu39wdLj4uypnOcWJKpD1Q_lK1HzU9HfwLAAD__1Acajg). Foreman is also known for promoting the George Foreman Grill, a kitchen appliance he touted in infomercials as “so good, I put my name on it.” The company that manufactured the device sold over 100 million units, [earning Foreman substantially more](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OozAURp_GdBfZF_OTwkVS0GW33BJd4AKW_BPZ3pDM048y_XSf9ElHR-fffbqTdTbsf8izKa8tTiixBdkA6mkl696TrlYzy_WiKjaq1zgoLbWqDqM22Sul5EILEq1y4KHrcGOcV03UNpU1H5hsUCvZ9rqth5nahdoOmS8DdiS05NWWmOpycOEX5c2945NTvURfOXOU8siiuQocBY7nedY-h88ncOQA_7PAMT9iKp8Ry8FJ4OhjLhA32DmmnWGLiT0FyBC4wBlTOWAhz7Cl6OGwGfZkncsQYoE5vmzYBY6U4HpVt3z7-lslsz5O65zNXS-03D1Z9yNYfi32NPgdAAD__6fYb7A) than he made during his entire boxing career. Following his retirement from boxing, Foreman appeared on sitcoms and became an ordained minister, leading revivals in the Houston area. He is the father of 12 children, including [five sons named George](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPtCAUAH8Ndhh4PkQLiq-x26-90qA8hQTFALfu_vvLXn_1JJPJfD3mhw0xnPt_e5Cpry3NIEBx0XHA2dkQ3zM2zizCjbIhIzXCIFGgbLzBlZTWKIdV0oh6XTYA5yQ5JfsRF9cE85GJDlAKpVG1w2LValUPROMAvWUoyIWacls9VXrZssV3elJu13Q00fhar8K6fwwmBtN93-3qczo_lMFUrpRrYTDZXMMaicG0U8o78S1lOuzJl_QK584j7XQ67tN3qenknnLiLlDhuucgoFOi0-3lryYbd90hxlB6zVDshw3xN6X--eZp4CcAAP__KbxnQw). On Saturday, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick proposed building a statue of Foreman in Houston similar to that of the fictional boxer Rocky in Philadelphia. “George was the real deal,” [said Patrick](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGngS3WcRwYBoYu7tJ0qtRu1jngGAnXkU1d5-2rdM_6D5_0f577M-eSv6_vPKdQj3HpEdCcQJ-Q-si53HuSMQwQvZIpqJbQKQJScgpe6WiR_cBJe-WZHDgcEtsxgiE_yhweGGgkBaYl07iBzYWNxZS8Q8uCIMVcl7WpU6rp4G0s92VPa3NZZlnCVOttE_pFYCewOx5VYPdWX5f940tgt1WuP5vATnnQRETOOjIaFCiUa4i331xK3mwrCK4z5_Lv1qeje8C_AAAA__-tXlHC).
## March Madness Update
Several Texas teams advanced to the Sweet 16 round in the NCAA men’s and women’s basketball tournaments, while four were eliminated in the first and second rounds. ## Six Texas Cities among Worst 50 for Allergies
The Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America [released its annual ranking](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2q6zAQBOCnkTub1Vo_VqHiNu5y21OajbWOBUokZBEnb39I-tMNDHwD83NZLhRTfNz-0519e215QUDdw9ijWgLF9F5UF_wVgpMde2kVTlKBkt3ut8mZTbkRJZAxji3aabtaZw2RDg666D8YjKgkaKv0MF1Jr6QNMrsJDQkFHGLLdWg7N37RsaV3fnId1nzvkt9bK4cY_wmcBc7neQ7rXvPj0wqcH3weAmeqLa6JBc4tl_6r9GtskY-eUuJ6-6TKJdfWI-AIVruh7KWrPpQzphQPY4WC251i-g63P594evwNAAD__0bYYFM) of the worst cities in the country for allergies, with six Texas cities in the top 50. The ranking assigned each of the nation’s 100 largest metros a score (on a 100-point scale) based on pollen count throughout the year, the prevalence of over-the-counter allergy medicine use, and the availability of allergists and immunologists. With a score of 100, Wichita, Kansas, is this year’s [worst city for allergies](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0jzFvhSAUhX8NbBq4gMrA0MXtde1ornBVEqwGyOvz3zc2Xd92ck5yvnxfj-mBMcXv9RN3cvW1HBMIMI1QDegpYEzXpHlwswhWcnKy1zBILbTkm1O6D4MQXTcr7XthFyAlpSVvrZFmMTy6-0wo0FKYXpt2mNF4NB0Q2QE6ZFpQiPXIbd2o0gvLkq7jSbn1x86T22o9C1MfDEYGI-KC7ZHXO5a67dhgSpTXq8lUCLPf7uW_8njGiqkwGHl24fyJKcXS9UyLdceY_gj1rfLTwW8AAAD__62KWJU), while the overall average is 68.57. Dallas ranks 13th on the list with a score of 80.19, while Houston is 26th with a score of 75.39. Last year, Dallas was fourth, and Houston was 14th. Further down the list, McAllen is 27th with a score of 75.31, San Antonio is 37th with a score of 73.50, Austin is 45th with a score of 71.51, and El Paso is 50th with a score of 69.62. Over 100 million people in the U.S. are affected by seasonal allergies. # [One of the most famous naval heroes in history suffered from seasickness.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| B ritain’s celebrated Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson was essentially the living embodiment of the hardscrabble "Four Yorkshiremen" of the classic Monty Python [sketch](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). As a young naval officer, he lost sight in his right eye from gravel strewn by an incoming cannonball. A few years later, he had his right arm amputated — without anesthetic — after being shot in the heat of another battle. Lord Nelson also weathered the debilitating effects of malaria, yellow fever, tuberculosis, scurvy, and dysentery at various points in his life. But the cruelest affliction may well have been the seasickness that plagued him for the duration of his three-plus decades at sea.
---
This unfortunate condition was revealed to many with the public display of an [1804 letter](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) in which Lord Nelson, then head of the British fleet in the Mediterranean, described his longtime struggles with boat-rocking waves. "I am ill every time it blows hard and nothing but my enthusiastic love for my profession keeps me one hour at sea," he wrote. Yet the seasickness hardly kept him from achieving stunning victories at the 1798 Battle of the Nile and the 1801 Battle of Copenhagen, the latter of which famously featured him holding a telescope to his blind eye and pretending not to see an order to retreat. While his death amid the British triumph over Napoleon’s army at the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar kept him from enjoying the spoils of success like the Monty Python characters, Nelson did them one better by becoming the first [nonroyal](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to receive a state funeral at St. Paul's Cathedral.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## A painting contest was held to depict Lord Nelson’s heroic death.
Britain's national love affair with Lord Nelson was perhaps best exemplified by a contest held for the painting that most dramatically captured his final heroic moments. One well-regarded [entry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) came from former Royal Academy of Arts President Benjamin West, who all but replicated 1770's "The Death of General Wolfe" by showing Lord Nelson lying in the arms of his crew on the deck of the HMS Victory. But the winner was the handiwork of Arthur William Devis, who secured his release from prison by promising to pay off his debts with the grand prize of 500 guineas. Devis was allowed onto the Victory to interview and sketch the crew members, resulting in the realistic touches that appeared in "The Death of Nelson, 21 October 1805." And yet it was undoubtedly the liberties taken with the [Christ-like](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stmkeh&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) portrayal of the revered naval commander, his shirtless body bathed in light and the backing pillow resembling a halo, that led to Devis claiming the award.

clean_body: Britain’s celebrated Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson was essentially the living embodiment of the hardscrabble "Four Yorkshiremen" of the classic Monty Python sketch. | B ritain’s celebrated Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson was essentially the living embodiment of the hardscrabble "Four Yorkshiremen" of the classic Monty Python . As a young naval officer, he lost sight in his right eye from gravel strewn by an incoming cannonball. A few years later, he had his right arm amputated — without anesthetic — after being shot in the heat of another battle. Lord Nelson also weathered the debilitating effects of malaria, yellow fever, tuberculosis, scurvy, and dysentery at various points in his life. But the cruelest affliction may well have been the seasickness that plagued him for the duration of his three-plus decades at sea. This unfortunate condition was revealed to many with the public display of an in which Lord Nelson, then head of the British fleet in the Mediterranean, described his longtime struggles with boat-rocking waves. "I am ill every time it blows hard and nothing but my enthusiastic love for my profession keeps me one hour at sea," he wrote. Yet the seasickness hardly kept him from achieving stunning victories at the 1798 Battle of the Nile and the 1801 Battle of Copenhagen, the latter of which famously featured him holding a telescope to his blind eye and pretending not to see an order to retreat. While his death amid the British triumph over Napoleon’s army at the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar kept him from enjoying the spoils of success like the Monty Python characters, Nelson did them one better by becoming the first to receive a state funeral at St. Paul's Cathedral. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Lord Nelson’s age when he joined the British navy 12 | | Guns on Lord Nelson's command ship, the HMS Victory 104 | Guns on Lord Nelson's command ship, the HMS Victory 104 | | Vessels that took part in the Battle of Trafalgar 60 | | Percentage of people who work on boats who experience seasickness 80% | Percentage of people who work on boats who experience seasickness 80% | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- A painting contest was held to depict Lord Nelson’s heroic death. Britain's national love affair with Lord Nelson was perhaps best exemplified by a contest held for the painting that most dramatically captured his final heroic moments. One well-regarded came from former Royal Academy of Arts President Benjamin West, who all but replicated 1770's "The Death of General Wolfe" by showing Lord Nelson lying in the arms of his crew on the deck of the HMS Victory. But the winner was the handiwork of Arthur William Devis, who secured his release from prison by promising to pay off his debts with the grand prize of 500 guineas. Devis was allowed onto the Victory to interview and sketch the crew members, resulting in the realistic touches that appeared in "The Death of Nelson, 21 October 1805." And yet it was undoubtedly the liberties taken with the portrayal of the revered naval commander, his shirtless body bathed in light and the backing pillow resembling a halo, that led to Devis claiming the award. This morning, the U.S. Supreme Court will hear oral argument in a case, _Louisiana v. Callais_ , that’s connected to a core American value: every person’s basic right to equal representation in the halls of power.
Black Louisianans have fought tenaciously for that principle of equality, and last year they finally secured a new congressional map that no longer dilutes their political power.
**But this case will determine not only the future of Louisiana’s Voting Rights Act-compliant map — it could also impact the future of the law itself.**
The Voting Rights Act of 1965 is the crown jewel of the civil rights movement. When it was signed into law nearly 60 years ago, it provided groundbreaking progress and necessary, overdue change.
**But this seminal law’s foundational values are under attack, threatening the very citizens it is meant to protect.**
Over decades, anti-democracy forces have tried to configure electoral maps in order to minimize the political power of communities of color. Critical protections enshrined in Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act — which prohibits lawmakers from diluting the political power of communities of color — are designed to protect those communities. And in recent years, _they did_.
Over the last few years, federal courts repeatedly struck down egregiously racially gerrymandered maps in states like Alabama and Louisiana, where the courts found that the maps passed by those states’ legislatures obstructed Black voters’ equal participation in the political process.
Rather than accepting that result and drawing maps that lawfully provide communities of color with equal opportunities, however, extremists turned to the U.S. Supreme Court, asking it to change the rules and attacking Section 2.
In their 2023 _Allen v. Milligan_ decision — a profound victory for the fair maps movement — the U.S. Supreme Court rejected Alabama leaders’ attempt to further undermine the Voting Rights Act, refusing to invalidate Section 2 of the law.
**After _Milligan_ , Louisiana finally enacted a VRA-compliant map — capping years of litigation where our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, supported Louisiana voters in their fight.**
This map ensures that Black Louisianians can exercise their long denied but rightful voting power, finally ensuring they are able to elect the candidate of their choice for Congress on an equal basis.
But unfortunately, that was not the end of the story: One of the most ideologically driven, conservative federal courts in the country struck down Louisiana’s fair map, ignoring the Supreme Court’s extremely recent precedent in _Milligan_.
**That brings us to where we are today.**
The case in front of the Supreme Court this morning should not be difficult to resolve. Federal law, the Supreme Court’s own precedent, and basic fairness dictate that Black Louisianians must vote on truly representative and fair maps.
A decision that does not recognize that fact or that weakens the Voting Rights Act of 1965 would signal an alarming retreat into a past that so many have fought so long and so hard to pull the country from.
**Now, the eyes of the nation are on the Supreme Court. No matter what happens next, All On The Line will be here to fight gerrymandering and help ensure fair representation – in Louisiana, and across the country.**
I’m proud that our affiliate has fought alongside voters in states like Louisiana as they struggle for full, equal participation in our democracy. With your support, the All On The Line campaign will continue to expose attempts at map manipulation, rally activists against proposals that would silence voters’ voices, and advocate for policies that keep political power where it belongs: in the hands of the American people.

Dear Hello The amount of excitement has been incredible since I announced a run for governor just over 2 and a half weeks ago, as evidenced by the massive grassroots organization of volunteers collecting signatures to get my name on the ballot across the state.
Just this weekend alone, our immediate campaign team turned in over 182 sheets, 2,184 signatures, in record time. We had an incredible showing at the gun show. We even had people driving from Northern Virginia just to sign the petition.
That said, we are about half way there, to our 10,000 signature goal. Our campaign is rolling forward like a massive snowball, which is picking up speed and momentum every day, until we cross through the finish line NEXT THURSDAY when we turn in our petitions to the Virginia State Board of Elections.
With this last full week ahead of us, we are asking you to ramp up collecting and recruiting of others to collect signatures. We still have a full weekend to collect signatures.
Anyone can get members of their household to sign a petition, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office. But we need more committed people to going to busy shopping centers, church parking lots and anywhere there are many people gathered in line and waiting. Please do your part to ensure we collect enough signatures to make sure we cross the finish line when we hand in our petitions next Thursday, April 3 before 5pm.
Tonight, I will be in Loudoun County speaking at their GOP meeting. But we will also have volunteers at these locations collecting signatures as well.
Monday, March 24 Loudoun County (Amanda speaking) 5:30pm GOP social, Mika's Neapolitan Pizza, Sterling, VA 7-8pm GOP meeting, Cascades Celebration and Corporate Event Center
Chesterfield County GOP meeting 6pm-8:30pm, Swift Creek Middle School, Midlothian, VA
Amherst County GOP meeting 6:30-8:30pm, 186 Dillard Road, Madison Heights, VA
Arlington County GOP meeting 6:30-8:30pm, The Leadership Institute, 1101 N Highland St, Arlington

Thursday, March 27 Henrico GOP meeting (Amanda speaking) 6:30-8:00pm, 4301 East Parham Road, Richmond, VA 23228

THIS WEEKEND Please stop by the Hampton Gun Show this weekend to sign the petition to get my name on the ballot or drop off your notarized petitions.
We will have a booth, so please drop by and pick up a free sweatshirt or t-shirt while supplies last. I plan to be there on Saturday from 9am to 3pm but we will have volunteers there the entire time. If you would like to volunteer, please give us call at 804 370-8727 or email amanda@chaseforva.com.
Saturday, March 29-Sunday, March 30 Hampton Gun Show Hampton Roads Convention Center 1610 Coliseum Drive Hampton, VA 23666
Saturday 9-5pm Sunday 10-4pm
If there are other large gatherings of 100 or more people, where we could collect signatures, please email us at amanda@chaseforva.com or call 804 370 8727.
Unable to attend? If you would like to sign my petition, but you are unable to attend one of these events, you can simply print off the petition, and get your family members to sign.
Please print off the petition at[ www.chaseforgovernor.com ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010LG8Zh6fPtQUnyp6xFryKjHvIRi0Z9_0Sv5MvnqHkFyn_fQUPwc6G9m-uM-ESJxFnWGYPEE1fJvdmv5wtkTgqyVnWGijRvLcrOWaDIUuGUxnoBZZf70edcCDBdwLvL0mrqv4KwOZTXMTCvNZn8Ni7QnAFUFJgLRl&c=-Ct7sJ_rEHpGzffAq35OgQJNcGCBC4iggHeE6HAV-8509SVl4xhvhw==&ch=ZyKc0qufjBmPJeGYtWpm_zPj_b2pd9TUIewi66MWewkHKf6VwUvz6w==)so that it is double sided and then collect signatures, but you can't sign your own petition, witness each signature, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office to:
Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522
We still need all hands on deck. We still need to collect 400 in each Congressional District. So no matter where you live in the state, we need your help collecting signatures.
Give us a call at 804 370 8727 and we will walk you through what to do, or you can read instructions below.
Many of you are still collecting. Please go ahead and Fed Ex to us the ones that you have already signed in front of a notary, so our team can verify the signatures. It takes about 20 minutes to verify each petition.
Then, please continue collecting.
I am so impressed with the commitment level of so many of you. And I want you to know I am just as committed, working every hour of the day to collect and verify our signatures at night.
Keep this in mind. We need a minimum of 400 signatures in each Congressional District. That's about 35 pages of signatures. So please keep going to parking lots across Virginia to find gracious people willing to sign our petition.
We must collect 10,000 valid signatures, 400 in each Congressional District, and as a campaign, turn the signatures into the State Board of Elections before Thursday, April 3 at 5pm.
We would like to receive all forms before Monday, March 31, so that we can properly organize and vet the signatures before turning them in to the Virginia State Board of Elections.
Hundreds of you have reached out and are actively collecting signatures. Thank you. It's only through your efforts that my name will appear on the ballot.
Currently, our campaign is 100 percent run by volunteers in each locality. We have no paid staff. The amazing organization you've seen from my campaign is all run by volunteers who want an American First Governor, who can beat Abigail Spanberger in November.
If 500 people collect just 2 pages or 24 signatures, we meet our goal. Will you commit to helping?
Thanks to many of you who have already answered that call. If everyone does their part, you will be able to vote for me in June. If not, you won't have a choice.
We have a team of grassroots volunteers in every Congressional District across the state actively collecting signatures. To join a team in your area, please reply to this email and I will personally connect you with volunteers in your area.
In order for you to vote for me on June 17, please print off the attached petition and collect the signatures of your family, friends and neighbors, so that I can get on the ballot.

Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.

6. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522

name: Newt Gingrich
subject: Help stop judicial tyranny with 1 click
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Million Voices
body:
debate is raging right now about how to rein in lawless judges.

| | | | |
---
Friend,
A debate is raging right now about how to rein in lawless judges.
We're in good company, as aside from "no taxation without representation," reforming the judiciary was among the American colonists' principal complaints about the British Empire prior to the Revolution.
This must be solved, or we will soon find ourselves living under judicial tyranny.
_**But what if I told you that right now, you could personally help to safeguard against this in a real and tangible way?**_
On April 1, voters in Wisconsin will decide the balance of their Supreme Court. In this critical race, one candidate believes in taxpayer benefits for illegal aliens, unrestricted abortion-on-demand, cashless bail, and of all things, is against Voter ID in elections.
The outcome of this race could mean the end of Wisconsin as a swing-state for years to come, and it could severely impact not only our presidential elections, but overall representation in Congress and election integrity.
**As you read this, Million Voices has already personally reached over 215,000 Wisconsin voters to arm them with information and help mobilize them to vote.**
**[Your tax-deductible donation, right now, will directly support this vital effort, and help to protect our courts from unconstitutional, left-wing activism. Will you help?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfgq9dp5mtdmkk2hktralk4j5mjgponi94hk175o_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6aor6clh2bs)**
|
---
[FIGHT JUDICIAL OVERREACH >>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs5qpchha0udlucderdkk57avdvv9ob5c39khff8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6aor6clh2bs)
|
---
**George Soros has been pouring money into this race, and it's not because he has any great affinity for or connection to Wisconsin. **
What he does know is that tearing down the America envisioned by our Founders requires stacking our courts with judges who will put far-Left politics over the Constitution.
**If we are going to rein in lawless judges, people like you and I must engage in these fights, even when they're in places we may not call home.**
Our Founders knew full-well the threats of judicial tyranny. They endured it themselves. We must now carry that torch forward and stop it wherever we see it.
**[So please, before we run out of time, please support Million Voices' efforts on the ground in Wisconsin. The election is April 1, and early voting has already begun.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z1i6i6nbpfb2dtdpk4i4b4h3b8p08j8ge0o3tj5g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6aor6clh2bs)**
Thanks for your time and commitment.
Your friend,Newt

Judge Jeanine Pirro **[snapped at Jessica Tarlov on"The Five"](https://substack.com/redirect/12f1ef3a-28b1-4cf1-b210-5235d38fd27e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for suggesting Republicans don't care about special needs children as they dismantle the federal Department of Education.
_**" Let me tell you something,... Don't make it sound like these kids are being forgotten!!" **_
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/12f1ef3a-28b1-4cf1-b210-5235d38fd27e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/12f1ef3a-28b1-4cf1-b210-5235d38fd27e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I hear Republicans out there talking about their plan for education in American, I don't hear them talking about making sure disabled kids have access to a public education," Tarlov said. "And you have all these religious cooks, the Superintendent of Oklahoma who wants to spend millions of dollars on Trump bibles, because it's all a grift!"
Judge Jeanine holding her head, annoyed by what she just heard, stepped into the ring. "Let me tell you something..."
"Number one, **[we are one nation under God and don't make a joke about that!"](https://substack.com/redirect/12f1ef3a-28b1-4cf1-b210-5235d38fd27e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** she said bluntly. "Number 2! The Department of Education has wasted $100 billion per year! So cut the crap! You yourself admit they don't do any education.
"And let me make something also clear!" Judge continued. "The Department of Education was created by an executive order by Jimmy Carter as a payback to the unions,... And we're going to end it the same way, with an executive order followed by a decision by congress!"
Jeanine finished by explaining that special needs programs handled by the Department of Ed are not being thrown out, but instead moved to other areas of the government that will remain intact. **["Don't make it sound like these kids are being forgotten!" ](https://substack.com/redirect/12f1ef3a-28b1-4cf1-b210-5235d38fd27e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

subject: Puppet-masters for our future elections
disclaimer_text: paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation
body:
You’re one of America’s most informed seniors

| |
---
| | I’m writing to you because YOU understand the George Soros threat.
---
| |
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3e11cagmi8thakdo27tdomj9ccmbvrs53e8sni0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs)
---
| | **STOP SOROS**
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zv76e57g3ogh4ns0br0vr0ogvkkqsn3gh2m5i0eg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.
---
>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z4954thu67k3rl9k69tg3268d3luqr375i6nngqo_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs)**
---
[ **STOP SOROS**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zaigo43oktimsil70bac72lcmob0c26c5tj12an0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs)
---
Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zo1qf2q6uqrdvqejnqpb7j1l4gdh5kft5fimrn4o_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of conservative seniors, “action” is what we’re known for.**With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to left-leaning AARP. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zqb9flsiut64ret7eohgemsuudhj7hmclp4ceke8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zojkhm4k8t8420afcs8e5jg70jpd8srkagmu68e0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zhfheh2m853cruru9lelronpcu8o8crmok807m6o_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.
---
| | For Freedom,
---
**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**
---
| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z91vldlanvg24bon4uussped443v3k9tl46ij700_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs)
---
| | P.S. The country of Hungary passed a “Stop Soros Law” and so can we! To do it, **[**AMAC Action needs your signed STOP SOROS petition and your one-time contribution of $35 or more to expand this petition drive**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zkcf4l38dadj0hd5jcbh9f60m3jn9nv6d2uj9rp8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3j6ep74slh2bs)**. Thank you for taking action when action is needed!

subject: We need a Paul Revere moment
body:
Unfortunately most Democrats out there still don’t know that we could pull off a groundbreaking and unprecedented win in FL-06. We are in desperate need of a Paul Revere moment in FL-06.
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001npQk-XWjLdKt1B-9p8ohBMXfomFxzcDy5mi84OufAJdVnfkVp_tyFJC7b3HzYO7QYUGeuYSmA1j3kaLlJhdYp-flFCZwrBGSYDKbN2kzTgk7PC7tG_oKN8H7htu9Ep8KIA-Ca9DfG1sPtJgP9mDxKzSM0sGHjSNUBprjoon_BaTjZgokxE3_LzLzStmi_odUJjPy5taGnGlpyVNHJAl14HmXbMXIybn6b8EXTmtoXEk=&c=bWT8oRiYPsA3Xv6l0MaNOVHrNQFwMIgsiz91RyRoPIkHHjL1TbU2og==&ch=RK990TlAU-y97aq1rZ9b5IZ4wzUdq2sdKo7YWZNqDtCtHzd6S3gjpg==)
---
Team,
After months of struggling to get this race the attention that it deserves, slowly but surely, word is finally getting out.
Just yesterday I was invited to appear as a guest on MSNBC to talk about our race.
---
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001npQk-XWjLdKt1B-9p8ohBMXfomFxzcDy5mi84OufAJdVnfkVp_tyFJC7b3HzYO7QEsowWo1c0e6Exv6SNkt4LNJCb7KiN__r0-PknhkPO3b38tNMsvygpT9WEsqEnVLDQ_A4Q7b3tE8HVBPMVbN-G_Z3R4GslHdJ-8Ur-ml9ML10xF-vDCe-5SyhHT23i9ynFicSGxjeTEE1UBexN1k5LB92d4C-RxFc&c=bWT8oRiYPsA3Xv6l0MaNOVHrNQFwMIgsiz91RyRoPIkHHjL1TbU2og==&ch=RK990TlAU-y97aq1rZ9b5IZ4wzUdq2sdKo7YWZNqDtCtHzd6S3gjpg==)
---
| | | | While the growing attention is promising. News of our lightning breakthrough here is not getting out quickly enough.
In 2021, Senators John Ossoff and Raphael Warnock were able to garner that level of attention, and the entire movement came together to push them over the line for their historic victory. Winning our race requires nothing short of these levels of support.
Unfortunately most Democrats out there still don't know that we could pull off a groundbreaking and unprecedented win in FL-06. We are in desperate need of a Paul Revere moment in FL-06. Shout it from the rooftops - "The Democrats are coming."
Can you [donate](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001npQk-XWjLdKt1B-9p8ohBMXfomFxzcDy5mi84OufAJdVnfkVp_tyFJC7b3HzYO7QpdVx91fQcxlFEEXdVLe0DSBBj50IXghfY4mJfaJJH6m-TNENC3o5ku3hG-WMveNJcRHFve6ZVl9P7ohPshwuKVN2WiYuG5m_KBxqVbSvV3FmMhmLB1jzFMBro2QtXPczlUHmGm5zNQadYCxltD4LyP5DPXo22VtlpZUZvl_8O7c=&c=bWT8oRiYPsA3Xv6l0MaNOVHrNQFwMIgsiz91RyRoPIkHHjL1TbU2og==&ch=RK990TlAU-y97aq1rZ9b5IZ4wzUdq2sdKo7YWZNqDtCtHzd6S3gjpg==) and/or [volunteer](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001npQk-XWjLdKt1B-9p8ohBMXfomFxzcDy5mi84OufAJdVnfkVp_tyFO77cbAH52YI2IWM2Ok_-GMeaP1z2o_ymc1bJqqp3kseJ9NNHI0VJON1ALLt0NNl4IQMsHZjLeg8lCr2MNLmBIDmdsxeaDEnnZQUQLYatjVg_ag4bBwh9JziQuv7W-u6b5w_ebNOdpyvq8nsjSC7eQ8=&c=bWT8oRiYPsA3Xv6l0MaNOVHrNQFwMIgsiz91RyRoPIkHHjL1TbU2og==&ch=RK990TlAU-y97aq1rZ9b5IZ4wzUdq2sdKo7YWZNqDtCtHzd6S3gjpg==), and at a minimum tell at least one friend or family member about the race? Even better, share our content and post on your socials about the race, text the family group chat, tell your local Congressman, do anything in your power to get the word out.
If the word gets out - we win.

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: Market Swings & Your Portfolio: What Really Matters
body:
| Hi Peter, I hope this email finds you well! You've seen the headlines—market selloffs, recession worries, and trade tensions have investors on edge. But here's the thing: Market moves like this aren't new, and they certainly aren't the end of the story. So, what's really happening? And more importantly, what should you do about it? **What's Happening**
* Economic Uncertainty: Citigroup just downgraded U.S. equities to neutral, citing economic uncertainty. That doesn't mean we're heading off a cliff—it means investors are recalibrating their expectations.1
* Trade Tensions : The U.S. slapped new tariffs on key imports, prompting immediate responses from Canada, Mexico, and China. These moves add short-term volatility and long-term uncertainty (but it's too early to know for sure how these moves will play out).2
* Market Roller Coaster: The S&P; 500, Nasdaq, and Dow all took hits, with the Nasdaq suffering its worst single-day drop since 2022 on Monday the 10th. Even Magnificent Seven stocks like Tesla and Nvidia were down significantly.3

Sure, all this can be scary when you see it dominating the headlines. But what is the bigger picture? **The Big Picture** Market turbulence can feel like a gut punch, but history tells us that patience pays. Take March 2000: The Nasdaq was flying high after a five-year rally, only to drop 60% over the next year. Brutal, right? But investors who stayed the course saw strong recoveries in the years that followed.4 Take a look at this sketch. Think about its message.
---
|
---
**We. Get. To. Decide. What. We. Focus. On.** When it comes to investing, that means you have a choice. Left side: You can tune into the financial networks, go through endless cycles of "buy buy, sell sell," obsess over the latest financial product, and deal with the apocalypse du jour while cycling through all the emotions that come with it. OR... Right side: You can focus on what actually matters when it comes to investing. And that's time. A very long time: decades. The takeaway? **Your investment strategy shouldn't be dictated by headlines.** **Looking Ahead** With key inflation data coming up, we could see more market swings. But staying grounded in a well-thought-out strategy is the difference between reacting emotionally and investing wisely.
1. **Stick to Your Plan.** Your investment strategy is built for the long haul, not week-to-week swings.
2. **Look for Opportunities.** Volatility creates buying opportunities for long-term investors. If you're considering adjusting your portfolio, let's talk about smart, strategic moves.

**Market swings are normal, but you don't have to go through them alone. We're in this with you, through every market cycle. If you want to talk through anything, just reply—we're here to help.** Sincerely,
---

Dear Peter,

This is Scott Kaspar here, General Counsel of the Illinois Review. This is a tough piece to write. For the past two years, Illinois Review has been exposing the fraud within our state party to help conservatives understand why we don't win races in Illinois. So much of those lost elections keep coming down not to Democrat voters, but to the malicious actions of our own state party leadership. Below is yet another example.

The state party's policy on mailers is that the IL GOP does not oppose Republican incumbents. Well, here is a story where the IL GOP is meddling with a Republican incumbent – a Trump Delegate, to be clear – in of all races but a nonpartisan fire district race, literally the election at the bottom of the ballot.

If you're running for State Representative or State Senate, good luck to you, because your state party is focused on hyper local nonpartisan fire district races this cycle.

By Illinois Review

A new mailer bearing the Illinois Republican Party’s postage permit surfaced this weekend in a race supporting preferred candidates against the Trump Delegate incumbent, signaling that the IL GOP has resumed its postage discount scheme – a practice that has kept the state party a target in an ongoing federal post office investigation.

As President Ronald Reagan famously stated, “There you go again.”

Two years ago, this publication revealed that the Illinois Republican Party had
weaponized (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-weaponized-postage-discount-to-attack-conservative-candidates-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) its postage discount to attack conservative Republican candidates during the Spring 2022 primary. Initially the IL GOP denied allowing preferred candidates to use its postage discount, until IR obtained exclusive audio (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/exclusive-audio-don-tracy-admits-irvin-campaign-used-il-gop-postage-discount-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) from then Chairman Don Tracy admitting to the scheme.

The practice continued again in
Will County (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/will-county-gop-establishment-tries-to-discredit-concerns-over-mailers-but-theyre-creating-more-questions-than-answers-instead.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) races in Spring 2023. The scandal ultimately led to former Will County GOP Chair Tim Ozinga’s resignation.

Sources have confirmed to IR that the matter had been referred to the Inspector General of the United States Postal Service, who still may be conducting an independent investigation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/sources-senior-us-post-office-officials-probing-potential-il-gop-postage-discount-abuse-reaches-the-inspector-generals-office-in-washington.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .

Despite assurances from former IL GOP Chair Don Tracy that the party would stay “strictly neutral (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-attacks-illinois-review-over-postage-discount-says-gop-strictly-neutral-during-governor-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) ” in contested races between Republican candidates, it appears the IL GOP is back in the game of allowing its preferred candidates to use its postage discount in contested elections against other Republicans.

This past weekend, Republican voters in Chicago suburb Orland Park, Illinois, received a mailer indicating that it was “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” supporting three candidates for a nonpartisan fire district race.

The incumbent who these IL GOP-endorsed candidates are trying to oust?

Trump Delegate and GOP donor Beth Damas Kaspar (https://fiscalvoicesfororlandfire.com/beth-damas-kaspar/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f94e9c0705-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
