March 24, 2025
I cannot look at my Facebook page or Twitter (X) feed without seeing Senator Murphy bashing President Trump. His attacks are vicious, vile, scatological and for Trump-hating Democrats, effective.
He offers no message other than President Trump is an illegitimate president who wants to give tax cuts to billionaires while slashing Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security. He opposes Trump's plan to end the Ukraine War, parroting the Democratic base's mantra "Give War a Chance." Ironically, these same people once chanted "Give Peace a Chance" decades ago.
To some extent, Murphy has Trump to thank for his success. While Trump is known for destroying political dynasties - the Bushes, the Bidens, the Clintons, the Obamas and the Cheney's - he has also been a main factor in destroying the mainstream media while giving rise to social media, especially Twitter (X).
The mainstream media was beginning to struggle before President Trump arrived on the scene. The internet made news free. Advertising revenue for newspapers plummeted. The Hartford Courant, the oldest newspaper in the United States, is now a shell of its former self and does not even have offices. The New York Times, once the paper of record, lives in fear of its liberal readers, who will cancel their subscriptions in mass because of a single conservative op-ed.
Furthermore, the rise of the internet created oligarchs with unfathomable amounts of money. Thus, Elon Musk bought Twitter (X) and Jeff Bezos purchased the Washington Post.
But President Trump picked up where President Obama started, using Facebook, then Twitter (X) and then at his son Baron's advice, podcasts. President Trump's three-hour podcast with Joe Rogan garnered over 46,000,000 views and was instrumental in President Trump's garnering a large percentage of young male vote including 33% of Black men under 35.
Trump embraced Elon Musk, who campaigned tirelessly for Trump in Pennsylvania and was rewarded with the task heading DOGE, the Department of Government efficiency.
Between Musk and Trump, their Twitter (X) feeds hit hundreds of millions daily. President Trump does not rely on the mainstream media to get his message out, he uses Twitter (X). And his former celebrity journalist detractors - Joy Reid, Don Lemon and Jim Acosta - are now bagging groceries.
Thus the savvy Murphy concluded, "If you can't beat 'em; join 'em." Unlike other boring political videos (that means you Senator Blumenthal), Murphy's are passionate and generate millions of views. He is fast becoming a national Democrat and presidential player without having to raise ridiculous amounts of money or attending every rubber chicken even in Iowa and New Hampshire. And even if he obtains interviews on MSNBC and CNN, their viewership is low, and he is already preaching to the converted.
The 51-year-old Murphy separated from his wife of seventeen years and mother to his two children and is now dating an attractive 39-year-old, Tara McGowen.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e9df56f-af50-4051-b260-e57578221cca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Senator Murphy and Ms. McGowen at a local Washington D.C. watering hole
But [Ms. McGowen](https://substack.com/redirect/b4d54b75-b776-492a-b4d9-9e11600daa7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is not just another pretty face. A self-described "childless woman voter," she is a genius at social marketing, having co-founded Lockwood Strategy in 2017 and ran digital ads for Planned Parenthood and the National Democratic Redistricting Committee. She was instrumental helping Democrats take over the State Legislature in Virginia and turning the state from Purple to Blue. She has set up political PACs that have raised millions for the Democrats.
Presently, she is the publisher of Courier Newsroom, a left-leaning digital media company. With this position, she has been able to raise her new boyfriend's political profile with expertly produced viral videos and tweets that reach all corners of the Democratic blogosphere.
Senator Murphy could not have found a better person to fulfill his political ambitions.
Republicans are chortling how the Democratic Party has lost its way and that their approval is at an all time low. Usha Vance and Casey DeSantis are already arguing over the curtains for the Oval Office in 2028.
This is silly. No one can predict what the political milieu will be in three years. If someone told you in 2008 that a Black man named Barack Hussein Obama would be elected president for eight years and then be replaced by Donald Trump, you would have called 911 to get that person immediate psychiatric help. But that is exactly what happened.
The Democrats are in search of a new leader, and with Ms. McGowen's help, that leader could be Senator Chris Murphy. And Republicans must take Senator Murphy seriously, very seriously.

His attacks are vicious, vile, scatological and for Trump-hating Democrats, effective. He offers no message other than President Trump is an illegitimate president who wants to give tax cuts to billionaires while slashing Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security. He opposes Trump's plan to end the Ukraine War, parroting the Democratic base's mantra "Give War a Chance." Ironically, these same people once chanted "Give Peace a Chance" decades ago. To some extent, Murphy has Trump to thank for his success. While Trump is known for destroying political dynasties - the Bushes, the Bidens, the Clintons, the Obamas and the Cheney's - he has also been a main factor in destroying the mainstream media while giving rise to social media, especially Twitter (X). The mainstream media was beginning to struggle before President Trump arrived on the scene. The internet made news free. Advertising revenue for newspapers plummeted. The Hartford Courant, the oldest newspaper in the United States, is now a shell of its former self and does not even have offices. The New York Times, once the paper of record, lives in fear of its liberal readers, who will cancel their subscriptions in mass because of a single conservative op-ed. Furthermore, the rise of the internet created oligarchs with unfathomable amounts of money. Thus, Elon Musk bought Twitter (X) and Jeff Bezos purchased the Washington Post. But President Trump picked up where President Obama started, using Facebook, then Twitter (X) and then at his son Baron's advice, podcasts. President Trump's three-hour podcast with Joe Rogan garnered over 46,000,000 views and was instrumental in President Trump's garnering a large percentage of young male vote including 33% of Black men under 35. Trump embraced Elon Musk, who campaigned tirelessly for Trump in Pennsylvania and was rewarded with the task heading DOGE, the Department of Government efficiency. Between Musk and Trump, their Twitter (X) feeds hit hundreds of millions daily. President Trump does not rely on the mainstream media to get his message out, he uses Twitter (X). And his former celebrity journalist detractors - Joy Reid, Don Lemon and Jim Acosta - are now bagging groceries. Thus the savvy Murphy concluded, "If you can't beat 'em; join 'em." Unlike other boring political videos (that means you Senator Blumenthal), Murphy's are passionate and generate millions of views. He is fast becoming a national Democrat and presidential player without having to raise ridiculous amounts of money or attending every rubber chicken even in Iowa and New Hampshire. And even if he obtains interviews on MSNBC and CNN, their viewership is low, and he is already preaching to the converted. The 51-year-old Murphy separated from his wife of seventeen years and mother to his two children and is now dating an attractive 39-year-old, Tara McGowen. | | ---|---|--- Senator Murphy and Ms. McGowen at a local Washington D.C. watering hole But is not just another pretty face. A self-described "childless woman voter," she is a genius at social marketing, having co-founded Lockwood Strategy in 2017 and ran digital ads for Planned Parenthood and the National Democratic Redistricting Committee. She was instrumental helping Democrats take over the State Legislature in Virginia and turning the state from Purple to Blue. She has set up political PACs that have raised millions for the Democrats. Presently, she is the publisher of Courier Newsroom, a left-leaning digital media company. With this position, she has been able to raise her new boyfriend's political profile with expertly produced viral videos and tweets that reach all corners of the Democratic blogosphere. Senator Murphy could not have found a better person to fulfill his political ambitions. Republicans are chortling how the Democratic Party has lost its way and that their approval is at an all time low. Usha Vance and Casey DeSantis are already arguing over the curtains for the Oval Office in 2028. This is silly. No one can predict what the political milieu will be in three years. If someone told you in 2008 that a Black man named Barack Hussein Obama would be elected president for eight years and then be replaced by Donald Trump, you would have called 911 to get that person immediate psychiatric help. But that is exactly what happened. The Democrats are in search of a new leader, and with Ms. McGowen's help, that leader could be Senator Chris Murphy. subject: The anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge
body:

---
| |
---
Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you...
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=dbff8231ac464116a36a170ae8ac8368&_e=mX2kZhaxtNMRT9KHCpN6gNLbtZLfWWXSXNSu6afS7wG6vzqWWTkLmfoBcXiaJVtKa2oEMhetKg668LVKGCS3Y7vTAXELkRpwManZKsnH-3gNE3fg4C_Gfwc_UZ-m8rru6URixOunOn3oLK0EwBp5ROItWhjD-VixuWHIGthNhMikpFkZD2nvWxvXGsPYrR4AVv5VjAJo_YetROVMqIhCpnihbX8U-Bpd6SmImD8q-WVK-Wa4UxNQdDwl74Naj1y0zYQPAX8QQ4NJqMZY-XUAoK6jPoNvtfmrJnR07pycpAPqv6-xBrLjLDZY2Zl3Rj5a9UtraKfcL3_CiAeJ_MU_E6CM7N7mPxPY9965XFqdtZDC8bKy6q3XzTsxsTA8txC2)
---
...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group who has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policemen's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? _**[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have wrongly accused?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=dbff8231ac464116a36a170ae8ac8368&_e=mX2kZhaxtNMRT9KHCpN6gNLbtZLfWWXSXNSu6afS7wG6vzqWWTkLmfoBcXiaJVtKa2oEMhetKg668LVKGCS3Y7vTAXELkRpwManZKsnH-3gNE3fg4C_Gfwc_UZ-m8rru6URixOunOn3oLK0EwBp5ROItWhjD-VixuWHIGthNhMikpFkZD2nvWxvXGsPYrR4AVv5VjAJo_YetROVMqIhCpnihbX8U-Bpd6SmImD8q-WXcy7578R_ZPFNWxMnYvYrU_u_XvBX_sdFWYTS-Rl0WH0y-eXYMRvjrZZH7aeMheRt2O1R0-wxkWgq_g6DKtYHFZJHDPhVc090OYoPyrVN4dquSphTLhtU-zpqgKa2S0f5F92wsfRrnHKjj9k6EbdkV)**_** ** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _**[So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=dbff8231ac464116a36a170ae8ac8368&_e=mX2kZhaxtNMRT9KHCpN6gNLbtZLfWWXSXNSu6afS7wG6vzqWWTkLmfoBcXiaJVtKa2oEMhetKg668LVKGCS3Y7vTAXELkRpwManZKsnH-3gNE3fg4C_Gfwc_UZ-m8rru6URixOunOn3oLK0EwBp5ROItWhjD-VixuWHIGthNhMikpFkZD2nvWxvXGsPYrR4AVv5VjAJo_YetROVMqIhCpnihbX8U-Bpd6SmImD8q-WXmknHtQRSNYcYqKW8LPEe8iXWb-VL5Gl8w3hvn2Kt5R0L-pEjkweqpSQtGCodiCA7dTiTTt8Sdz12IHNV8jO72nXpyCd10FilXEMAlvAyl2dUOA3Cs8mlWGKJyRYiJCnkGcuDt3FpfkWI2CQG6Lj48)**_ But whatever you feel led to give, please end it back quickly. Chance's trial starts on July 7th. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he'll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle somebody... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. clean_body: ...Now looking at it makes me cry | | | The same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison for life for doing his job. | | Dear Peter, That's me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches in the picture I've sent you... ...a picture we took on the day Chance received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor for rescuing a driver from a crashed car that had caught on fire. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because in July, the same city that gave Chance this award... ...will try to lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. What I didn’t know then was that this nightmare wasn't over for us. Far from it. Unknown to Chance and the other officers on duty that night, an anti-police protestor was hit by one of my husband's non-lethal rounds. They claimed they were injured and lost part of their finger. And for that... ...the county prosecutor charged my husband with "aggravated assault by a public servant" -- a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free... ...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make cops pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars and could be his "reward." Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. Peter,
Since 2019, March For Our Lives has demanded the president create a national office focused solely on ending gun violence. In 2023, we secured the first-ever White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention!
This was a huge win that helped cities across the country respond to gun violence and allocated millions of dollars in federal grant money to communities in need.
**And within his first month in office, Trump dismantled it.**
But this fight is NOT over, Peter.
**Congressman Maxwell Frost is helping to lead the fight to defend our progress. He just introduced a bill to re-establish the Office of Gun Violence Prevention, which will:**
* Convene an Advisory Council of gun violence experts — ranging from survivors to teachers to government officials;
* Coordinate gun violence prevention efforts across federal agencies;
* Make policy recommendations;
* Educate the public about federal laws, regulations, and available grant programs;
* And provide an annual report to Congress on gun violence, including recommendations on policy initiatives to reduce it.

body:
Peter,

Seven years ago, young people around the world marched to demand action.
Since then, 24,395 children and young people have been shot and killed.

March For Our Lives was born because a group of students witnessed one of
the worst tragedies imaginable: a shooting at their high school in
Parkland, FL. Angry and traumatized, they put those feelings into action.

We refused to accept our so-called leaders’ excuses as they threw their
hands up and threw away our futures.

So we marched. We organized the largest single-day protest against gun
violence in history. Millions joined us. This was just the start.

Seven years have passed, and a lot has changed.

We’ve traveled the country and registered millions of voters. 🗳️

We’ve grown up and seen more youth leaders join the movement. 🗣️

We’ve fought to expand how people think of gun violence to go beyond mass
shootings. 🧠

We’ve pulled up a seat at the table for ourselves, with one of our own,
Maxwell Frost, becoming the first and only Gen Z member of Congress. ✊

We’ve broken youth voter turnout records year after year, and we’ve helped
pass over 300 gun violence prevention laws across the country that save
lives. 🔥

There’s still a ton left to do, but we will get it done. We will be the
generation that ends gun violence.

→ We stopped insurance companies from denying coverage for pre-existing conditions.

Friend,
A debate is raging right now about how to rein in lawless judges.
We're in good company, as aside from "no taxation without representation," reforming the judiciary was among the American colonists' principal complaints about the British Empire prior to the Revolution.
This must be solved, or we will soon find ourselves living under judicial tyranny.
_**But what if I told you that right now, you could personally help to safeguard against this in a real and tangible way?**_
On April 1, voters in Wisconsin will decide the balance of their Supreme Court. In this critical race, one candidate believes in taxpayer benefits for illegal aliens, unrestricted abortion-on-demand, cashless bail, and of all things, is against Voter ID in elections.
The outcome of this race could mean the end of Wisconsin as a swing-state for years to come, and it could severely impact not only our presidential elections, but overall representation in Congress and election integrity.

Hi folks, it’s Jenny, Tim Kaine’s Finance Director.
As you read this email and the others like it in your inbox, you may be wondering what a donation can actually do, given where we are in the election cycle.
But here’s the thing — even though the midterm elections are a year and a half away, right here in Virginia we’re less than eight months from major statewide elections!
Right now, Governor, Lt. Governor, and Attorney General are all offices held by Republicans, and Democrats have the chance to FLIP them BLUE this November. Plus, we need to hold onto our narrow majority in the Virginia House of Delegates.
Doing all of that is a top priority for Tim Kaine this year. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025] On top of his hard work in the Senate pushing back against the lawless Trump Administration, his political team in VA is doing everything they can to support our great Democrats running for office.
Flipping all of Virginia’s statewide offices from red to blue won’t be easy. Getting Democrats to the polls when many are exhausted from 2024 and ready to check out of politics isn’t just challenging, it’s expensive — so we have a lot of work to do. But it’s really, really important work. Not only will winning these races make a huge difference in Virginians’ lives, it will also send a message to the national GOP that voters are strongly against the extreme agenda they’re pushing.
This is our first chance to stand up to the Trump Administration, so we can’t hold back.
Tim’s Common Ground PAC is going to be working around the clock between now and November to support Democratic victories — because the fact is, Tim Kaine knows how to win in Virginia!
I’ve told Tim we need to raise $100,000 for Common Ground by the end of Q1 (just a week away!) if we want to stay on track for our ambitious work — so I’m coming to you for help.
If you’re ready to see big Democratic wins, will you pitch in a few bucks towards our goal and send a message that we’re going to bring the fight this year? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Photos from the road:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
We have been _hitting the road hard_ these last few days to connect with working people who have been abandoned by their Republican members of Congress.
Bernie and I held five rallies across three states in three days and were joined by 86,847 people of all walks of life.
We started the tour off in **Las Vegas, Nevada.** We rallied with 3,287 Nevadans against the oligarchy in this country, where we were joined by Rep. Steven Horsford, a former member of the Culinary Workers Union.
Then we went to **Tempe, Arizona** where even the overflow section had an overflow section! 15,000 folks joined us to fight for our future.
The next stop on the tour was **Greeley, Colorado** , where GOP Congressman Gabe Evans has refused to hold a town hall. Greeley has a population of 108,000 — and 11,300 of those Coloradans took time to join us on Friday.
Then it was onto **Denver, Colorado** where we were joined by 34,000 folks who were ready to roll up their sleeves! It was Bernie’s biggest rally ever and bigger than any Trump has ever had in Denver.
And finally the last stop was **Tucson, Arizona**. On a beautiful Saturday, 23,260 people turned out — making it the largest political rally in Arizona history. We were joined by Rep. Greg Casar, the Chair of the House Progressive Caucus.
In spite of what Trump wants you to believe, we are not powerless. All over this country, in both Democratic and Republican districts, people are ready to fight back and defend our democracy. They deserve leaders who will stand with them.
**Something special is happening.** Together, we are building a movement for transformative politics in this country that is rooted in social, economic, racial, and environmental justice.
These town halls have been possible because of thousands of people chipping in what they can, without a dime of corporate or lobbyist money.
[ We’re hoping to connect with even more people across the country. Will you donate right now to help our campaign host more town halls?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250324-1.h1kiT9&refcode=em20250324-8425-P_FND_RES_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8425%2E2526796%2EbVNcSH)
Every donation helps us mobilize, organize, and fight for the working class in the places that need it most.
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250324-1.h1kiT9&refcode=em20250324-8425-P_FND_RES_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=8425%2E2526796%2EbVNcSH)**
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250324-1?refcode=em20250324-8425-P_FND_RES_GRM&t=21&refcode2=8425_2526796_bVNcSH&akid=8425%2E2526796%2EbVNcSH)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250324-8425-P_FND_RES_GRM&t=22&akid=8425%2E2526796%2EbVNcSH)**

During the Senate floor debate on RFK, I argued: **_"If the Senate weren’t gripped in this soon-to-be infamous period of total capitulation, I don’t think this nominee would have made it as far as a hearing."_** Hours later, Senate Republicans totally capitulated — again — and confirmed to lead American public health a man famous only for his name and his embrace of conspiracist pseudoscience. _Total capitulation._ Historians will fill books about these months, when we witnessed the elected GOP's complete and catastrophic collapse of courage. They'll write about these Senators’ rubber-stamp confirmation of Trump's worst nominees. They’ll write about their dereliction of duty during an unprecedented attack on the role of Congress as a co-equal branch of government. **As Trump elevates utterly unqualified zealots and loyalists to the nation's most powerful offices, Republican Senators suspend their judgement, march onto the Senate floor, and vote AYE.** Some know better. You can see it in their faces. They look ashamed. They still vote AYE. That brings me to the 2026 election. **_2026 is our only hope to recover Congressional power and reverse this descent toward one-man rule._** And here in Georgia I am the _only_ Democratic U.S. Senator nationwide up for re-election in a state Trump won. I am therefore MAGA’s #1 target for defeat. **_There is no path back without defending this seat — the seat that secured the Democratic majority four years ago._** So I'm asking for your help. body:

**PLEASE READ THIS AND CONSIDER ACTING! IT WILL ONLY TAKE MINUTES BUT IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT!**

Thank you for subscribing & staying subscribed!

**BE SURE TO HAVE YOUR FAMILY & FRIENDS "JOIN US":**

---
| [Join Us!](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=cb51126e83&e=5c740fa3e2 "Join Us!")
---
| | | ** **
**CALL TO ACTION!
SPREAD THE WORD!
$2.5B BOND ISSUE ON
OHIO'S MAY PRIMARY BALLOT!
WHAT EVERYONE NEEDS TO KNOW!
WE MUST GET THE WORD OUT!**

---
| [**NEW**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c4f4da9e6e&e=5c740fa3e2)[**WEBPAGE FOR YOU TO BOOKMARK WITH RESOURCES TO HELP US ALL FIGHT ISSUE 2!**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=690eb82ddf&e=5c740fa3e2)

We [**PREVIOUSLY**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=fb0357d4da&e=5c740fa3e2) made you aware there's a bond issue on the Ohio primary election ballot in May. Now we must make sure others are aware! **EARLY VOTING STARTS APRIL 8TH!**

**HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN DO TO HELP!**

1) PLEASE **forward this message** to as many people as you can, especially those who typically would not vote in a primary election!
2) PLEASE download **[THIS GRAPHIC](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=5a4cbf0c08&e=5c740fa3e2) (same as below)** to your phone & send it to everyone you can, again, **especially those who typically would not vote in a primary election!
NEW >>>> 3)****** PLEASE **refer** as many people as you can **to the new Issue 2[WEBPAGE](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=17ccc7582f&e=5c740fa3e2)**!

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=48661d4dda&e=5c740fa3e2)
**(Click the image above to download!)
BACKGROUND ON THIS BOND ISSUE**
It's for $2.5B dollars with spending limits of $250,000,000 annually. Supposedly, it's necessary for the health and well-being of Ohio's infrastructure. We'll bet most Ohioans haven't heard about it and know almost nothing about it. That's intentional. It's taxpayer abuse. A great strategy might be to vote NO on it. Here's why in a short video. Once you've watched it, please SHARE it with everyone you can!
Thank you!

**EPISODE: "Ohio's Stealthy May Bond Issue"**

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=fbf7a21fcd&e=5c740fa3e2)

ONCE-IN-A-LIFETIME TRIP FOR TWO (2)!**

Only 500 tickets are being sold & they are $100 each. The Grand Prize is a trip for 2 to Normandy Beach as part of a French tour that Bob is hosting. All proceeds, $50,000, goes to the **Travis Mills Foundation**.
If you don’t win, it’s still a donation to a great cause!

| | | |

| | 'Nothing Worth Having Was Ever Achieved Without Effort.'Theodore Roosevelt
A thunderous roar is rising from the people, even as we face historically low confidence in the national Democratic leadership ([CNN](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=3SEAETBSJOW2nBQjzWTlwrzkZh-gEvbgeJnYoM8xIVM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY25uLmNvbS8yMDI1LzAzLzE2L3BvbGl0aWNzL2Nubi1wb2xsLWRlbW9jcmF0cy9pbmRleC5odG1sIiwiciI6ImFjYWQxNmJkLTZiMDctNDVkMS05MDA2LTRiZWI0N2YyMjI0OSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). Why? Because we are strong, we are rural America. Nobody works harder or cares more about our family, neighbors, and country than we do. We have less, give more, and ask for little. We are the first in line to offer help and the last in line to receive it. We are strong. From Okanogan to Klickitat and from Chelan to Spokane counties, we are on the streets, writing letters, making phone calls, holding workshops, and working with our local elected leaders to do more.
---
| |
---
| | Tri-Cities Indivisible Town Hall Session 1 March 23, 2025
---
| | Every day, I felt the waning hope of Democrats in Central and Eastern Washington, it was palpable. But in just a few short weeks of 47’s term, I hear and see an uprising like never before. People who once would not have lifted their sad butts off the couch are now lining the streets with placards, demonstrating their power. Where twenty attendees once constituted a great showing at a political event, we are now seeing hundreds. Recently, in the small community of the Methow, several hundred showed up for a [missing Dan Newhouse town hall](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=EtKDomqNIlGHUhJLiC64X_cCFBWv28co_GWShjJekiA.). In the Tri Cities, an [Indivisible group](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=rke4HqX28mZUwBqLHP62iwkcUF7VHO6PKVUEQnUIagk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL3Byb2ZpbGUucGhwP2lkPTYxNTc0MTk2NjA1Nzg1IiwiciI6IjE1ZmY3MzY2LTRhNGMtNDE3OS1iZTZhLThlNGI2ZWY5OTU4YSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) so new that their Facebook page had only four posts organized a town hall that grew so large they needed two sessions. In Spokane, a newly elected, extremely naive and arrogant MAGA, Mike Baumgartner, was crucified by a [massive turnout](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=oLfEAE-qy9nU87EMNe3cV7yeVSgDQJtApvxQnJYK03A.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1aUFdkajBxT3I4QSIsInIiOiIxNWZmNzM2Ni00YTRjLTQxNzktYmU2YS04ZTRiNmVmOTk1OGEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) of well prepared and angry constituents. Here in Yakima, where local Democrats have long struggled to get enough people to form a quorum, a new group is emerging. At its first meeting, eighty nine people showed up, and more are signing up for the next. Wonderful organizations like [Ella](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=SE1c-gzFeqZUI0zelb588p_PSqCIMhZCoS89_VnWV70.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWFyZWVsbGEub3JnLyIsInIiOiIxNWZmNzM2Ni00YTRjLTQxNzktYmU2YS04ZTRiNmVmOTk1OGEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) and [YIRN](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=-78SLnCXc7HzmlaGLkKG_jVrfL8nNdvi68WT9YaTQmQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL1lha2ltYUltbWlncmFudFJlc3BvbnNlTmV0d29yayIsInIiOiIxNWZmNzM2Ni00YTRjLTQxNzktYmU2YS04ZTRiNmVmOTk1OGEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) are holding workshops to educate us and our neighbors on how best to defend ourselves against the very real and personal threats being made against us by 47.
---
| |
---
| | One in ten people in Yakima County are at risk to ICE actions.Immigration, Social Security, Medicaid, federal worker firings, farm programs, and SNAP are all under attack by 47. These programs are essential to keeping our communities safe and economically stable. Yet we have representatives who neither know us nor care, CD 4’s Do Nothing Dan Newhouse and now Mike Baumgartner in Congressional District 5. Patty Murray is a strong senator, and we are fortunate to have her, but her focus remains on Hanford, where the big money rolls in. She has never given sufficient attention to the vast majority in this district who make their living from agriculture or lower paying manufacturing jobs. Now is the time for our elected officials to hear all of us! [It only takes 3.5%](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=bTf_bG_BXrA9XbOHHiVfRxTPp4mWGgj0yt_Iduww0u0.) You can face the future in two ways. You can internalize your fear and hope it passes with minimal pain, or you can find pride in yourself and your country and rise up. This is NOT the time to be a Schumer, now is the time to be an AOC or a [Bernie](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=qNj6uUfCTiL8bQUk4gGuJ8wnp08YKCo0ETMAxJt925Q.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnByLm9yZy8yMDI1LzAzLzIyL254LXMxLTUzMzQ0ODgvYmVybmllLXNhbmRlcnMtZmlnaHQtb2xpZ2FyY2h5LXRvdXItdHJ1bXAtbXVzay1kb2dlLWRlbW9jcmF0cyIsInIiOiJlYTA1Zjk0Yy02MmI0LTQ2MTEtOTU4Yi1mOWEwMGEyNDVmOGQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). There will not be a better time or another opportunity. As Rep. [Celeste Maloy](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=rR0b_aqDDe4UlM-oRn4SPw4eRkZGG_gpGmUNS_3_hfc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90aGVoaWxsLmNvbS9ob21lbmV3cy81MjA3MTU1LWNlbGVzdGUtbWFsb3ktZXhlY3V0aXZlLWJyYW5jaC1hdXRob3JpdGFyaWFuaXNtLyIsInIiOiJlYTA1Zjk0Yy02MmI0LTQ2MTEtOTU4Yi1mOWEwMGEyNDVmOGQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) (R Utah) warned, “I am concerned about the country careening toward authoritarianism if we don’t get the executive branch under control.”
---
| |

| | Methow Valley missing Dan Newhouse Town Hall
---
| | The future of Democratic candidates in Central and Eastern Washington is promising. In the last election cycle, opportunities were few, but with the pain in these communities being very real and clearly tied back to the Republican Party and 47, we now have a clearer path to victory.Despite Biden’s many great accomplishments, the public perception was overwhelmingly negative. With the benefits largely intangible or too removed to be sufficiently felt, it was easy for far right rhetoric to dominate. But shutting down Medicaid portals, threatening to stop Social Security checks, and waging tariff wars with our most important trading partner, those are real, and they cut deep. This is the time for Democrats to shout their truth and be heard.

| | Potpourri

| | Stop thanking Dan NewhouseDan Newhouse voted to impeach 47, yes. But since then, he has done everything he can to get back into the good graces of the far right. Any infinitesimal amount of moral fortitude he may have once shown was eclipsed by his egregious actions both before and after. Recently, Dan took the lead in bringing [censure against a colleague](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=Lo7WFSoRpHmhQxjeGCZh3ENuecreNFEYs48PX9YSGqA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlb2x5bXBpYW4uY29tL25ld3Mvc3RhdGUvd2FzaGluZ3Rvbi9hcnRpY2xlMzAxNTI3MzQ0Lmh0bWw_) who was outspoken against 47. Newhouse is not now, and never was, worthy of any praise or gratitude. Court Victories:Judge smacks down Brian Heywood's initiatives as “unconstitutional” ([Northwest Progressive](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/aePN9JFrB/c?w=wyRcVd8eyQckppQJF7aBt7otOHbyzD9NsRSl5S1KoqY.)) Yakima community group wins victory over MAGA majority City CouncilAs shared by Spencer Hatton, “Yes, we had a great day in court. The citizen committees on climate change and integration will be restored. Now let’s see what the City Council will do. Thanks for showing support for our cause. Long Live Democracy! Leslie & Spencer”

| | As Democrats, we have been given two once in a generation opportunities to win Congressional District 4 since Jay Inslee held the position more than thirty years ago. The first was when I, Doug White, ran in 2022, when Loren Culp made a Democratic victory possible. A similar scenario played out in Congressional District 3, where Democrat Marie Gluesenkamp Perez captured the "not so crazy" vote against Joe Kent and won. She has now proved that she, and we, can hold that seat with a reelection in 2024. The second is looking more and more like 2026. A path to victory is becoming clearer for 2026, and I will write more on this because my vision forward is stronger than ever, and I hope yours is too.

These programs are essential to keeping our communities safe and economically stable. Yet we have representatives who neither know us nor care, CD 4’s Do Nothing Dan Newhouse and now Mike Baumgartner in Congressional District 5. Patty Murray is a strong senator, and we are fortunate to have her, but her focus remains on Hanford, where the big money rolls in. She has never given sufficient attention to the vast majority in this district who make their living from agriculture or lower paying manufacturing jobs. Now is the time for our elected officials to hear all of us! You can face the future in two ways. You can internalize your fear and hope it passes with minimal pain, or you can find pride in yourself and your country and rise up. This is NOT the time to be a Schumer, now is the time to be an AOC or a . There will not be a better time or another opportunity. As Rep. (R Utah) warned, “I am concerned about the country careening toward authoritarianism if we don’t get the executive branch under control.” | | | | Methow Valley missing Dan Newhouse Town Hall | | The future of Democratic candidates in Central and Eastern Washington is promising. With the benefits largely intangible or too removed to be sufficiently felt, it was easy for far right rhetoric to dominate. But shutting down Medicaid portals, threatening to stop Social Security checks, and waging tariff wars with our most important trading partner, those are real, and they cut deep. The first was when I, Doug White, ran in 2022, when Loren Culp made a Democratic victory possible. A similar scenario played out in Congressional District 3, where Democrat Marie Gluesenkamp Perez captured the "not so crazy" vote against Joe Kent and won. **If we want to win, we have to meet people where they are, talk to them about the issues that matter most in their daily lives, and show up for them — not just during election season, but every single day._Andy knows this because it’s exactly how he’s won tough races in Kentucky._**

He’s beaten the odds — _twice_ — by proving that common sense, decency, and real leadership can win, even in deep red states. And now, he’s bringing that playbook to Democrats across the country to help them win, too. Make no mistake: extreme politicians are doing everything in their power to maintain control and gain even more seats.

They want to flip Democratic held seats and elect extremists in their place, and push an agenda that favors special interests and partisan chaos over an economy that works for families. If we want to stop them, we need to go on offense. That’s where In This Together comes in. We’re working to replicate the winning strategy that got Andy elected and make sure they know exactly who’s fighting for them.

We’ve seen this strategy work in Kentucky, and now we’re taking it nationwide to elect good candidates in the House and Senate who will stand up for the needs of their constituents, regardless of politics. But we can’t do it without you. This work takes resources, and with Republicans already targeting vulnerable seats, we need to scale up our efforts now.

## Trump's War on Black and Brown Immigrants
Here I documented just five examples of the Trump regime targeting legal and documented residents of the United States. They all have something in common--they're majority Black and brown. As the receipts below show you, Trump only objects to non-white immigration.
### 1\. Latino Americans Are Being Denied Due Process--And Deported Without Charges
Trump is rounding up and [sending hundreds of people to a known torture camp in El Salvador](https://substack.com/redirect/4161305a-b6b1-4370-8f04-63e047850699?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), all without due process. No charges. No trials. Just a presumption of guilt based on their ethnicity or language or neighborhood. When Trump's border Czar Tom Homan was asked what evidence exists to deport these individuals, and what precedent exists to deny them due process, [Homan refused to answer](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a8e45f-1909-4337-891b-a9537faa2fde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Fortunately, a Federal court Judge Patricia Millet has blocked Trump's fascist deportations while slamming his actions, stating:
> There were plane loads of people. There were no procedures in place to notify people. **Nazis got better treatment under the Alien Enemies Act**. There's no regulations, and nothing was adopted by the agency officials that were administering this. They people weren't given notice. They weren't told where they were going. They were given those people on those planes on that Saturday and had no opportunity to file habeas or any type of action to challenge the removal under the AEA. (emphasis added)
White supremacy is when the US Government treats genocidal Nazis better than it treats ordinary residents who have been charged with no crime whatsoever. The next four examples further prove this point.
### 2\. Mahmoud Khalil Is Here Legally--Trump Is Trying to Deport Him Anyway
Mahmoud Khalil is a legal U.S. resident. He has a green card. He has no criminal record. Yet he was recently abducted by ICE agents without a warrant, stripped of his rights, and is being held in an undisclosed location. Why? Because he dared to speak out in support of Palestinian human rights. This is not a case of someone "breaking the law." This is the U.S. government targeting a legal immigrant for his political views. That's fascism, plain and simple. [Read my full analysis of his abduction here](https://substack.com/redirect/71bce36f-45cf-41fa-aff9-edc9311e3b3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### 3\. Asylum Is Legal Immigration--Trump Is Blocking It
The right to seek asylum is enshrined in both U.S. and international law. Yet [Trump and his allies have moved to ban asylum](https://substack.com/redirect/8872f85e-5366-4193-9f65-bedbaffab6e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and continue to vilify asylum seekers, portraying them as criminals and invaders. In truth, seeking asylum is not only legal--it's a human right. But Trump's policies have made it nearly impossible, turning away desperate people fleeing violence and persecution. So much for "legal immigration."

[Trump arbitrarily blocked more than 1,660 Afghan refugees](https://substack.com/redirect/a3d7dd83-1e1a-4aa7-ad9c-b6b105a28071?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--many of whom risked their lives to help U.S. troops. These allies were thoroughly vetted and approved to enter the United States legally. These are not "illegal immigrants." They are individuals who were promised safety by the U.S. government, only to be abandoned when they needed us most. They did everything right, and were banned anyway.
### 5\. More Than 530,000 Immigrants Were Are Legally--Trump Just Revoked Their Status
More than half a million Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans were granted legal protection to live in the United States. [The Trump regime just stripped away that protection](https://substack.com/redirect/609001c7-524d-4677-be7e-22b2a6d0e50c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These individuals didn't "break the law"--they followed it, trusted it, and were legally permitted to be here. And now they're being targeted for removal solely because of who they are. Incidentally, [we know there are more than 500,000 undocumented mostly white Canadian and European immigrants in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/e7047e1d-cf6d-4e60-b895-f49acc0b2d14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). When was the last time you saw Trump send ICE after them? Never, because unlike Black and brown immigrants, they have the complexion for protection.
### Let's Call This What It Is
It has never been about legal vs. illegal immigration. Trump's policies make it painfully clear that this is about race. About using the legal system as a weapon to exclude, to erase, and to persecute people who are not white. And by the way, right wing media is fully on board with the creation of a white ethno-state. Just this week, Brian Kilmeade of Fox News [spewed](https://substack.com/redirect/263f8fa4-1179-44cc-87aa-170dae73f639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while referring to mass deportations of immigrants of color:
> It's not practical to think that we can do due process on 8 million people. There's 22 million people here at minimum, illegal already. If we are going to give ever these guys a day in court and a lawyer, we can't do it, they don't deserve it.
This is absolutely fascism. Due process is not an optional topping at Chipotle, it's a guaranteed foundational principle of our Constitution. To forsake due process is to forsake the American experiment altogether. And given that the MAGA party believes in the death penalty, how long before "_Its practical to do due process on 8 million people_ " means mass murdering them? If you can arbitrarily arrest and disappear a person, and eliminate due process, what is to stop genocide?

## What Can We Do?
We are not helpless, and we can act. Some of the seven action items below have immediate effect and others take time. Some require financial investment, others require time investment. All of them matter and I ask you to do what you can.
### **1\. Activate**
Get involved in your local politics. Whether it is your local school board, your local city council, or your local immigrant rights organization--get involved. Show up to the next meeting, meet your local elected officials, and understand the local issues impacting your community. Google is your friend in finding a local calendar of events. Use it. All politics is local, and it is critical you get involved locally.
### **2\. Communicate**
Contact your member of Congress ([find them here](https://substack.com/redirect/c933f120-fd44-442e-9ed7-779b55486dd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and relentlessly remind them that you do not support mass deportations. Instead, you do support due process of law, a humane immigration policy, and equal rights for immigrants. Ensure they hear your outrage as much as possible.
### **3\. Invest**
Invest your time and your money into the people and organizations doing the front line work. If you have time to volunteer, make phone calls, knock doors, and sign petitions, do so. If you have the financial resources to donate to organizations working to protect our democracy, like the Chicago based [National Immigrant Justice Center](https://substack.com/redirect/5e43fae2-34b3-40c5-a589-fc773fd135a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), please do so.
### **4\. Educate**
It is critical we remain informed on the key issues, by educating ourselves and those around us. As corporate media sadly continues to capitulate to fascism, support writers and human rights lawyers working to stop fascism in America (e.g. [like yours truly](https://substack.com/redirect/2af8ef3a-9e9b-4f2b-b162-a8972c5c570d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). Read the work of non-profit media like ProPublica, The Appeal, and more. We may not have the billions of dollars in dark money from corporate autocrats, but we have strength in numbers and your support makes that difference.
### **5\. Organize**
Bring friends with you. You are the best ambassador for justice in your friend group--lead by example. Grab even one friend and drag them with you to the next school board meeting, city council session, or town hall in your local community. We need to build organizational capacity, and means each one reaches one to get involved. (And when your friend comes to the second meeting, it is their opportunity to reach one more and bring them with).
### **6\. Sanctuary Locations**
During the previous Trump administration, reports estimate 800 or more churches, synagogues, and other houses of worship established themselves as sanctuary locations for immigrants. These are locations that invited immigrants who feared deportation to remain within their walls for housing, food, and safety. To be clear, these sanctuary locations have no particular legal authority, and ICE agents can still procure a warrant to search sanctuary locations and arrest anyone a judge has authorized for arrest.
However, certain faith groups established sanctuary locations anyway as another line of protection and safety for those fearing such raids, which required ICE to have to make the decision of whether they want to violently raid a house of worship. And given the imminent passing of the Laken Riley Act, which allows authorities to arrest and deport immigrants on the mere accusation of a crime[3](https://substack.com/redirect/9efc0333-167a-46a8-9c51-e3ec9d9652aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--including petty and non-violent crimes like shoplifting--sanctuary locations may see an increase in this Trump administration.
### **7\. Repeal 287g Agreements**
The Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996 added Section 287(g) to the Immigration and Nationality Act. This authorized ICE to force state and local police to do what ICE wants them to do--in this case, round up immigrants.[4](https://substack.com/redirect/47d861eb-5308-427c-861c-21a9dae5c9b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) In other words, 287g agreements allow federal ICE officers to require local and state police officers to work for them. These agreements are why it's incredibly risky to call local police on immigration issues. Currently, ICE has some form of a 287g agreement with hundreds of police departments across 25 states--[which I have uploaded here](https://substack.com/redirect/36f9b3e9-a5c6-4cf9-a2d4-ba79c124b2d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for your convenience.
**Here 's the key call to action**: 287g agreements cannot go into effect until local government approves their enforcement. That means, if your locality has a 287g agreement in place, it is because your local elected officials voted for it. Therefore, they can be repealed with that same local authority. So, if you live in one of the states or localities listed above, advocate to your city council, mayor, or relevant governing authority to repeal this harmful agreement and instead uphold meaningful justice.
## Conclusion
Due process of law is the foundation of protecting America's residents against tyrannical government. MAGA is tearing it down to install Trumpian autocracy. If we want a future where justice actually means something, we must be unapologetic in calling out this fascism--and even more relentless in organizing against it. Let's fight for an America where the rules apply equally on the tenets of justice, regardless of your race, religion, or birthplace.
Because if we don't, then believe when I write that fascism is a one way street, and there's no coming back.

Due process is not an optional topping at Chipotle, it's a guaranteed foundational principle of our Constitution. To forsake due process is to forsake the American experiment altogether. And given that the MAGA party believes in the death penalty, how long before "Its practical to do due process on 8 million people " means mass murdering them? If you can arbitrarily arrest and disappear a person, and eliminate due process, what is to stop genocide? What Can We Do? We are not helpless, and we can act. Some of the seven action items below have immediate effect and others take time. Some require financial investment, others require time investment. All of them matter and I ask you to do what you can. 1\. Activate Get involved in your local politics. Whether it is your local school board, your local city council, or your local immigrant rights organization--get involved. Show up to the next meeting, meet your local elected officials, and understand the local issues impacting your community. Google is your friend in finding a local calendar of events. Use it. All politics is local, and it is critical you get involved locally. 2\. Communicate Contact your member of Congress () and relentlessly remind them that you do not support mass deportations. Instead, you do support due process of law, a humane immigration policy, and equal rights for immigrants. Ensure they hear your outrage as much as possible. 3\. Invest Invest your time and your money into the people and organizations doing the front line work. If you have time to volunteer, make phone calls, knock doors, and sign petitions, do so. If you have the financial resources to donate to organizations working to protect our democracy, like the Chicago based , please do so. 4\. Educate It is critical we remain informed on the key issues, by educating ourselves and those around us. As corporate media sadly continues to capitulate to fascism, support writers and human rights lawyers working to stop fascism in America (e.g. ). Read the work of non-profit media like ProPublica, The Appeal, and more. We may not have the billions of dollars in dark money from corporate autocrats, but we have strength in numbers and your support makes that difference. 5\. Organize Bring friends with you. You are the best ambassador for justice in your friend group--lead by example. Grab even one friend and drag them with you to the next school board meeting, city council session, or town hall in your local community. We need to build organizational capacity, and means each one reaches one to get involved. (And when your friend comes to the second meeting, it is their opportunity to reach one more and bring them with). 6\. Sanctuary Locations During the previous Trump administration, reports estimate 800 or more churches, synagogues, and other houses of worship established themselves as sanctuary locations for immigrants. These are locations that invited immigrants who feared deportation to remain within their walls for housing, food, and safety. To be clear, these sanctuary locations have no particular legal authority, and ICE agents can still procure a warrant to search sanctuary locations and arrest anyone a judge has authorized for arrest. However, certain faith groups established sanctuary locations anyway as another line of protection and safety for those fearing such raids, which required ICE to have to make the decision of whether they want to violently raid a house of worship. And given the imminent passing of the Laken Riley Act, which allows authorities to arrest and deport immigrants on the mere accusation of a crime petty and non-violent crimes like shoplifting--sanctuary locations may see an increase in this Trump administration. 7\. Repeal 287g Agreements The Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996 added Section 287(g) to the Immigration and Nationality Act. This authorized ICE to force state and local police to do what ICE wants them to do--in this case, round up immigrants. In other words, 287g agreements allow federal ICE officers to require local and state police officers to work for them. These agreements are why it's incredibly risky to call local police on immigration issues. Currently, ICE has some form of a 287g agreement with hundreds of police departments across 25 states-- for your convenience. Here 's the key call to action: 287g agreements cannot go into effect until local government approves their enforcement. That means, if your locality has a 287g agreement in place, it is because your local elected officials voted for it. Therefore, they can be repealed with that same local authority. So, if you live in one of the states or localities listed above, advocate to your city council, mayor, or relevant governing authority to repeal this harmful agreement and instead uphold meaningful justice. Conclusion Due process of law is the foundation of protecting America's residents against tyrannical government. MAGA is tearing it down to install Trumpian autocracy. If we want a future where justice actually means something, we must be unapologetic in calling out this fascism--and even more relentless in organizing against it. Let's fight for an America where the rules apply equally on the tenets of justice, regardless of your race, religion, or birthplace. Because if we don't, then believe when I write that fascism is a one way street, and there's no coming back. Quick Ask! body:
Hegseth, Waltz, and Vance cannot give us any certainty that their communications have not been intercepted by China, Russia, and Iran. They cannot guarantee to us, to the public, and to the members of the United States Military that our enemies don't already have access to our most sensitive secrets.
#
Peter,
On March 15th, the Military began strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen.
At 1400, the public found out about it.
But at 1144, more than two hours earlier, **Pete Hegseth accidentally texted the war plans to a reporter for The Atlantic.**
**This is a colossal f*ck up.** The Secretary of Defense, the Vice President, the National Security Advisor, the Director of the CIA, and virtually every other top-level Trump Administration member shared information critical to the safety of American Troops over unsecured channels with someone uncleared to receive it.
**This is the most basic security test imaginable, and the leadership of our National Security apparatus failed it.**
It’s one thing to accidentally add your mother-in-law to your fantasy football group chat. It’s another entirely when the top floor of the Department of Defense accidentally adds a reporter to a group chat that includes timetables, targets, and weapons packages — critical details for an imminent strike. **YOU DON’T TEXT THIS STUFF!**
If a reporter for The Atlantic can get these plans accidentally we need to be sounding the alarm **_immediately.**_ Hegseth, Waltz, Ratcliffe, and Vance cannot give us any certainty that their communications have not been intercepted by China, Russia, and Iran. They cannot guarantee to us, to the public, and to the members of the United States Military that our enemies don't already have access to our most sensitive secrets.
When the bullets start flying, things like this get good people killed.
The worst part? We warned everyone about this. We shouted from the hilltops that Pete Hegseth was woefully unprepared and unqualified, and had no place at the top of the most powerful Military in the history of the world. This is the result.
**VoteVets is demanding that everyone involved in this FUBAR situation on March 15th is hauled in front of a Congressional hearing to answer for it.** If any corporal or lieutenant did the same, they’d already be in Leavenworth. Waltz, Hegseth, Vance, and the rest of the JV squad leading the Military right now should each lose their jobs over this.
But, to start, we’ll settle for some rigorous oversight.
[**Join VoteVets in calling on NSA Mike Waltz, CIA Director John Ratcliffe, Secdef Pete Hegseth, VP JD Vance, and anyone else involved before Congress. Now.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250324_vv_em_accountability/?source=em250324-1-90&akid=34280%2E3013755%2EkQAYKb)
| [Demand accountability](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250324_vv_em_accountability/?refcode=em250324-1-90&akid=34280%2E3013755%2EkQAYKb)
---
Thank you,
The team at VoteVets

name: Gov. Tony Evers
subject: It’s official: Trump’s firing of federal workers is illegal.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
Multiple judges have ruled against these firings, but the fight isn’t over.
| Derek,

I want to give you a quick update on the lawsuit Wisconsin and multiple other states filed earlier this month against the Trump Administration over the illegal firings of federal workers. Let me take a moment to explain – and then to ask you to [**support my work in this fight.**](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2660?source=te_ata_em_fr_fedworkers_250319_t1_1&t=5&akid=7110%2E1827488%2E1wJYvP)

In the last several weeks, the Trump Administration has fired thousands of federal workers, making drastic cuts to programs that our kids, families, seniors, and farmers depend on and messing with lives and livelihoods – all to pay for tax cuts to the ultra-rich.

So I joined a multi-state lawsuit against the Administration for these reckless, illegal firings.

**Here’s the good news: Recently, as a result of that lawsuit, a federal judge ordered the Trump Administration to reinstate thousands of federal workers who were fired in these rash cuts. Already, at least 24,000 employees are in the process of being reinstated.** (And it wasn’t even the only decision last week ruling these firings illegal!)

But this fight is far from over. The Trump Administration is already looking to make other large-scale cuts that will have truly devastating effects on Wisconsin and the country, including to the Department of Education and the VA.

Gutting the departments that make our country run – much less the ones that serve the most vulnerable among us, and those who have put everything on the line for our country – is wrong, full stop. It also flies in the face of the “government efficiency” Trump and Elon Musk claim to be pursuing – so far, it’s only resulted in chaos and confusion.

**I will never stop fighting for Wisconsin, and against illegal moves like this that leave our state worse-off. But I need your help:[If you’re able, chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to keep up the fight.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2660?source=te_ata_em_fr_fedworkers_250319_t1_1&t=6&akid=7110%2E1827488%2E1wJYvP)**

Onward,

[](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2660?source=te_ata_em_fr_fedworkers_250319_t1_1&t=7&akid=7110%2E1827488%2E1wJYvP)

Tony Evers

name: March For Our Lives
subject: Seven years of work
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Folks,

Seven years ago, young people around the world marched to demand action. Since then, **24,395 children and young people have been shot and killed.**

March For Our Lives was born because a group of students witnessed one of the worst tragedies imaginable: _a shooting at their high school in Parkland, FL._ Angry and traumatized, they put those feelings into action.

We refused to accept our so-called leaders’ excuses as they threw their hands up and threw away our futures.

**So we marched.** We organized the largest single-day protest against gun violence in history. Millions joined us. **This was just the start.**

**Seven years have passed, and a lot has changed.**

We’ve traveled the country and **registered millions of voters.** 🗳️

We’ve grown up and seen more **youth leaders** join the movement. 🗣️

We’ve fought to expand how people think of gun violence to go beyond mass shootings. 🧠

We’ve pulled up a seat at the table for ourselves, with one of our own, **Maxwell Frost,** becoming the first and only Gen Z member of Congress. ✊

We’ve **broken youth voter turnout records** year after year, and we’ve helped pass over **300 gun violence prevention laws** across the country that save lives. 🔥

There’s still a ton left to do, but we will get it done. **We will be the generation that ends gun violence.**

[Friend, we can’t do it without you — YOU are a part of our story. Help us fight for our futures by making a split donation between us and Voter Protection Project today.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/88322?t=6&akid=19352%2E878179%2E9lZGeS) If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between March For Our Lives and VPP will go through immediately. | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/88322?t=7&akid=19352%2E878179%2E9lZGeS)

Dear friend,
I am proud to announce that my campaign will be participating as a partner in the 2025 National Democracy Summer School! This one-of-a-kind Democratic Fellowship—founded by Congressman Jamie Raskin and expanded across the country in an historic partnership with the DCCC—is dedicated to recruiting thousands of high school and college-age students and training them as the next generation of Democratic political activists and leaders.
As part of this educational and political initiative, I am looking for 5 dedicated high school and college students to join me here in AZ-04 as Team Stanton Democracy Summer Fellows!
APPLY HERE! [https://democracy-summer.breezy.hr/p/56bc66278a24]
This six-week program will take place from Monday, June 23rd to Friday, August 8th and requires a commitment of 10-15 hours per week. Fellows will participate in exciting online seminars and a powerful curriculum designed by Congressman Raskin, while also organizing on-the-ground with my reelection campaign here in AZ-04.
Throughout the academic portion, Fellows will learn from academic luminaries, inspiring political leaders, policy experts, issue advocates and top community organizers from all across the country. Past Democracy Summer speakers have included House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, Professor Laurence Tribe, Senator Elizabeth Warren, Rep. Bennie Thompson, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and the late Rep. John Lewis.
Not to mention, Fellows will also learn state-of-the-art skills in phone-banking, text-banking, canvassing, on-line organizing, low-dollar fundraising and voter registration—all the necessary ingredients for a thriving field operation! You can click the link HERE [https://democracy-summer.breezy.hr/p/56bc66278a24] and scroll down to find the application for our campaign. If you know a student who may be interested in this life-changing and America-changing program, please forward them this email—they won’t want to miss out!
Thank you for your support and solidarity,
Rep. Greg Stanton

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

In times like this, it’s important to highlight when democracy and the rule of law are upheld. In the courts, judges are blocking the Trump administration’s dangerous, imperialist executive orders left and right.

Now, more than ever, we must join the courts and use our voice to ensure our values are upheld. **_[Will you be one of the 1,000 supporters we need to sign our petition today and fight back against extremism? body:
I know that if you only call on the loudest, highest hands—you will only be hearing the voices of a select few.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39568%2E3422442%2EBQelzJ)
Derek,
Americans are concerned about what the Trump agenda is doing to our government and our economy, but our elected leaders are in hiding. **More and more Congressional Republicans are refusing to hold town halls, because they don’t want to answer to constituents.**
That’s not how you represent people.
I held many town halls throughout my time in Congress, and to make sure I heard from a variety of voices during each one, I would invite everyone to submit their questions on index cards. Then, I put all the cards into a bingo ball spinner and randomly selected questions.
**I did this because as a teacher, I know that if you only call on the loudest, highest hands—you will only be hearing the voices of a select few.** By democratizing the process of asking questions, I was able to hear from all sorts of people.
There’s no excuse for elected officials not hearing from constituents. It is what you sign up for when you run for office, and it’s a core part of the job.
**As Governor, I won’t hide from Californians.** I’ll listen to everyone's concerns, and I'm willing to work with anyone who has a good idea.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Donald Trump announced right-wing religious extremist Mike Huckabee to be
the next Ambassador to Israel, and the Senate vote to confirm him is
likely happening this week.

We cannot overstate how dangerous this is. In his own words:

“There is no such thing as a[n Israeli] settlement” in Palestine.^1

“There is no such thing as an occupation [of Palestine].”^2

“There is no such thing as a Palestinian.”^3

Huckabee blatantly denies the existence of Palestinians, erasing them as a
people with rights and history. He refuses to acknowledge the illegality
of Israeli settlements built on stolen Palestinian land and denies the
very existence of Israel’s more than half-century military rule over
Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140615?t=1002&akid=36527%2E1203867%2EFQHyAT ]The Palestinian people deserve peace and justice, not a continuation of
genocide and ethnic cleansing fueled by American tax dollars. Your voice
matters — send a letter to your Senators NOW to demand a vote against
Huckabee.

Huckabee doesn’t support Netanyahu’s far-right government and its genocide
against Palestinians just because he’s a racist and Islamophobe — though
he is – but also because he’s a far-right Christian Nationalist like GOP
Speaker Mike Johnson and Trump’s Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

This sort of dangerous extremism belongs nowhere near the White House or
any position in our government.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140615?t=1003&akid=36527%2E1203867%2EFQHyAT ]So please, use this link to write a letter to your Senators asking them
to vote NO on Mike Huckabee’s nomination to be Ambassador to Israel. We’ve
included a letter template, or you can write your own.

Send a Letter

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

"**APD: 'Incendiary device' found at Austin Tesla dealership showroom on North U.S. 183** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Karoline Leonard** -- "Incendiary devices were found at an Austin Tesla dealership on Monday morning, according to a news release from the Austin Police Department.

APD officers responded to a call at the Tesla dealership on North U.S. 183 at 8:04 a.m. Monday and found "suspicious devices" upon their arrival, according to the release. The devices were later determined to be incendiary by the APD Bomb Squad and were taken into custody without incident.

Incendiary devices, according to the Department of Justice, are usually weapons or munitions designed to start fires, cause burns or respiratory injury through flames or heat.

The event comes as Tesla vehicles, showrooms and charging stations nationwide experience vandalism, protests and attacks in recent weeks in response to mounting frustration over CEO **Elon Musk's** involvement with the federal government.

Several protests have taken place outside of the Tesla showroom on North U.S. 183, including one on Saturday led by ResistAustin.
