body:
Chip in now to help ensure we can use every tool at our disposal to protect fair maps
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104443609/535375768/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxYWYwNjFjLWZkMDgtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4azjBkTiYN0D5oRF_dZabAFbp7qertynhlUAnfDGTNQ=&emci=1a485c31-f308-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=61af061c-fd08-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=8431045)
---

The topic of gerrymandering is back in front of the Supreme Court today, Peter. Fair maps are on the line in _Louisiana v. Callais_ , where extremists are challenging an electoral map that has finally led to fair congressional representation for Black Louisianans. The court’s ruling will not only determine the future of Louisiana’s Voting Rights Act-compliant congressional map, but could also impact fair maps in Alabama and Georgia, and the future of the Voting Rights Act at large. **As a key member of the NDRC community, you need to see this memo from our executive director outlining what we’re up against and our path to fighting back.[If you don’t have time to read the full memo right now but would still like to support the NDRC’s critical work, you can do so by clicking here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104443610/535375769/790884352?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_VRAMemo_email_20250324-NDRC-Tier1-VRAMemo_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250324-NDRC-Tier1-VRAMemo_&utm_campaign=VRAMemo&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxYWYwNjFjLWZkMDgtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4azjBkTiYN0D5oRF_dZabAFbp7qertynhlUAnfDGTNQ=)** | **From:** Marina Jenkins, Executive Director, National Democratic Redistricting Committee
**To:** Interested Parties
**Date:** February 2025
**Subject:** Republicans are Targeting Voting Rights Act to Gerrymander Ahead of 2026 Midterms Republicans are aiming to use the courts to erase Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (VRA), a critical safeguard for fair maps, as part of a larger strategy to gerrymander the congressional map ahead of the 2026 midterms. **Litigation Challenging VRA-Compliant Maps Could Tip 2026 House Majority** Three lawsuits in states across the South could tip control of Congress in 2026. In each of these lawsuits, Republicans are arguing for the reversal of newly VRA-compliant maps that resulted from the enforcement of the U.S. Supreme Court’s landmark 2023 decision in _Allen v. Milligan_ , which upheld Section 2 of the VRA. These three lawsuits alone could determine whether or not the national congressional map remains the fairest map we have seen in decades or reverts to a gerrymander by dismantling at least three Black opportunity districts — potentially more than the current House majority. Here’s where Republicans are aiming to dismantle VRA-compliant maps:
* Georgia (_Pendergrass v. Raffensperger_): As a result of success in court, Georgians won a new Black opportunity district in their congressional map. But, Republicans have appealed the court decision enforcing those maps, and are attempting to dismantle that new district. The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit held oral argument in the case on January 23, 2025, and a decision is expected by summer.

* Alabama (_Caster v. Allen_): The Alabama congressional map now includes two Black opportunity districts, and that map allowed Alabama voters to elect two Black Members of Congress for the first time in history in the 2024 election. But Republicans are aiming to eliminate the new Black opportunity district in court which could lead Alabama to again have just one Black opportunity district. A two-week-long trial began on February 10, 2025, before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Alabama.

* Louisiana (_Robinson v. Callais_): Louisiana’s congressional map now includes two Black opportunity districts, and that map allowed Louisiana voters to elect two Black Members of Congress for the first time in nearly 30 years. However, a challenge was brought against the map in an effort to not only dismantle the state’s new Black opportunity district, but also to potentially undermine Section 2 of the VRA, which would have significant implications nationwide. The oral argument in the case is set to take place before the U.S. Supreme Court on March 24, 2025.

**Conclusion** Gerrymandering has remained central to Republicans’ long-term political strategy. Their goal is to revert the current congressional map — a map that will allow both parties to compete for the House majority for the rest of the decade — to one that ensures a durable Republican majority for years to come. Dismantling Section 2 of the VRA would give Republicans further free reign to gerrymander without accountability. This builds on Republican tactics leading up to the 2024 election, when Republicans enacted an egregious partisan gerrymander in North Carolina, changing the 50-50 state’s fair 7-7 congressional map to a 10-4 gerrymander. That gerrymander ensured Republicans could pick up three additional seats leading up to the 2024 election, delivering Republicans a three-seat majority in the House. What transpired in North Carolina was another step in the Republican playbook to revert the national congressional map into a durable gerrymander that guarantees one-party rule — and they are kicking off this year in pursuit of the next step in that playbook. This underscores the need to protect the progress that has been made to ensure equal representation.

clean_body: Chip in now to help ensure we can use every tool at our disposal to protect fair maps | The topic of gerrymandering is back in front of the Supreme Court today, Peter. Fair maps are on the line in Louisiana v. Callais , where extremists are challenging an electoral map that has finally led to fair congressional representation for Black Louisianans. The court’s ruling will not only determine the future of Louisiana’s Voting Rights Act-compliant congressional map, but could also impact fair maps in Alabama and Georgia, and the future of the Voting Rights Act at large. As a key member of the NDRC community, you need to see this memo from our executive director outlining what we’re up against and our path to fighting back.= | From: Marina Jenkins, Executive Director, National Democratic Redistricting Committee To: Interested Parties Date: February 2025 Subject: Republicans are Targeting Voting Rights Act to Gerrymander Ahead of 2026 Midterms Republicans are aiming to use the courts to erase Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (VRA), a critical safeguard for fair maps, as part of a larger strategy to gerrymander the congressional map ahead of the 2026 midterms. Litigation Challenging VRA-Compliant Maps Could Tip 2026 House Majority Three lawsuits in states across the South could tip control of Congress in 2026. In each of these lawsuits, Republicans are arguing for the reversal of newly VRA-compliant maps that resulted from the enforcement of the U.S. Supreme Court’s landmark 2023 decision in Allen v. Milligan , which upheld Section 2 of the VRA. These three lawsuits alone could determine whether or not the national congressional map remains the fairest map we have seen in decades or reverts to a gerrymander by dismantling at least three Black opportunity districts — potentially more than the current House majority. Here’s where Republicans are aiming to dismantle VRA-compliant maps: Georgia (Pendergrass v. Raffensperger): As a result of success in court, Georgians won a new Black opportunity district in their congressional map. But, Republicans have appealed the court decision enforcing those maps, and are attempting to dismantle that new district. The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit held oral argument in the case on January 23, 2025, and a decision is expected by summer. Alabama (Caster v. Allen): The Alabama congressional map now includes two Black opportunity districts, and that map allowed Alabama voters to elect two Black Members of Congress for the first time in history in the 2024 election. But Republicans are aiming to eliminate the new Black opportunity district in court which could lead Alabama to again have just one Black opportunity district. A two-week-long trial began on February 10, 2025, before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Alabama. Louisiana (Robinson v. Callais): Louisiana’s congressional map now includes two Black opportunity districts, and that map allowed Louisiana voters to elect two Black Members of Congress for the first time in nearly 30 years. However, a challenge was brought against the map in an effort to not only dismantle the state’s new Black opportunity district, but also to potentially undermine Section 2 of the VRA, which would have significant implications nationwide. The oral argument in the case is set to take place before the U.S. Supreme Court on March 24, 2025. Conclusion Gerrymandering has remained central to Republicans’ long-term political strategy. Their goal is to revert the current congressional map — a map that will allow both parties to compete for the House majority for the rest of the decade — to one that ensures a durable Republican majority for years to come. Dismantling Section 2 of the VRA would give Republicans further free reign to gerrymander without accountability. This builds on Republican tactics leading up to the 2024 election, when Republicans enacted an egregious partisan gerrymander in North Carolina, changing the 50-50 state’s fair 7-7 congressional map to a 10-4 gerrymander. That gerrymander ensured Republicans could pick up three additional seats leading up to the 2024 election, delivering Republicans a three-seat majority in the House. What transpired in North Carolina was another step in the Republican playbook to revert the national congressional map into a durable gerrymander that guarantees one-party rule — and they are kicking off this year in pursuit of the next step in that playbook. "**APD: 'Incendiary device' found at Austin Tesla dealership showroom on North U.S. 183** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Karoline Leonard** -- "Incendiary devices were found at an Austin Tesla dealership on Monday morning, according to a news release from the Austin Police Department.

APD officers responded to a call at the Tesla dealership on North U.S. 183 at 8:04 a.m. Monday and found "suspicious devices" upon their arrival, according to the release. The devices were later determined to be incendiary by the APD Bomb Squad and were taken into custody without incident.

Incendiary devices, according to the Department of Justice, are usually weapons or munitions designed to start fires, cause burns or respiratory injury through flames or heat.

The event comes as Tesla vehicles, showrooms and charging stations nationwide experience vandalism, protests and attacks in recent weeks in response to mounting frustration over CEO **Elon Musk's** involvement with the federal government.

Several protests have taken place outside of the Tesla showroom on North U.S. 183, including one on Saturday led by ResistAustin. The protest was part of the nationwide #TeslaTakedown efforts, that rally against Musk's role in Trump's administration. The protest Saturday was peaceful and took place outside the Tesla showroom along Pond Springs Road.

Representatives at the showroom declined to comment and directed media to Tesla's national press team, who have not responded.

Friend, With U.S. weapons, the Israeli military has violated the temporary ceasefire in Gaza. On March 18 Amnesty International’s Secretary General said, “Israel brazenly resumed its devastating bombing campaign in Gaza killing at least 414 people in their sleep” in one night, including more than 170 children.1 Additionally, the Trump administration bombed Yemen, killing children and other civilians in one of the most impoverished countries in the world. Since October 2023, our government has sent over $18 billion to fund the ethnic cleansing and extermination of Palestinians. **Each year, most of my colleagues in Congress also vote to pass yet another record-breaking military budget. Even though the Pentagon has failed to pass an audit for 7 years in a row, last year the Pentagon budget was $895 billion, nearly $1 trillion taxpayer dollars.** And now, congressional Republicans are attempting to add another $150 billion to the Pentagon budget and $175 billion to the Department of Homeland Security to help carry out Donald Trump’s cruel and illegal mass deportations. **Republicans are trying to cut hundreds of billions of dollars from essential programs that millions of Americans rely on, including Medicaid and food stamps... while adding hundreds of billions of our taxpayer dollars to the military budget.** This is**** impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Why do we always have money for war, but not enough to feed the poor, as Tupac Shakur wrote decades ago? **Part of the problem is the deep ties between lawmakers and the weapons industry. Half of the annual military budget** **lines the pockets of military contractors that profit off of mass death.** Now, many of these contracting corporations have proposed taking over mass detentions and deportations, as well.2 Weapons corporations like Raytheon, Boeing, and Lockheed Martin spend millions to re-elect Congresspeople who serve on committees that determine military funding. Additionally, **many members of Congress and their spouses invest directly in weapons contractor stocks, so when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally.** Across political party lines, too many of my fellow Congresspeople are incentivized to push for military aggression rather than diplomacy.**** To stop this, I introduced the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_. [**Please add your name to support my newly introduced bill, the**** _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_****. It’s time to ban members of Congress from owning stock in weapons corporations, and push our government to invest in our communities, not corporate profits.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsum1kU5oByp_ITgVWKFt75_lQTHT3xcVrqtk6GnxA32yrIXH6wSj2k9uCkcm98elARwDvz9gPt5EXLWQiKS9Wu6ABZTox9Smb8BqoBmjIaNfezkDPoLlKjhJI5Yc-T6HcGB4HRmC_cgcRckGcp6Jf7K56ZXPkkfAXMXYLUuby3_32xzAWve-TQcs2mpeTGcGrfScQ15adGKLb97yYZkNsUfjgwL-6Al2Vaudf4WNvMvf4vCt09jCcyr4D0QvCsEPUz_XJwtsw8f1s4MCNuZpbIA8BKIaxIv1mlfBXy1pxdVcq3HOcuPFJ8zbkSPfyaeiq-u_wrek6mE6YAqaL_q-zjjA/4f2/LJ3QL1reR--QeBvbes0nYg/h1/h001.pckAjhzgB64c26vxMkLBFLXfSjzvc-tkDhUvZqSijAQ) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsum1kU5oByp_ITgVWKFt75_lQTHT3xcVrqtk6GnxA32yrIXH6wSj2k9uCkcm98elARwDvz9gPt5EXLWQiKS9Wu6ABZTox9Smb8BqoBmjIaNfezkDPoLlKjhJI5Yc-T6HcGSwc23qt_Flk4HbD2NuQt6QyjOAmWK4titSgMp0pUxxhkfQbLHfuUAkUO6ZF_P7kYWz5Z_zzokwiNXr_hIMyeuHmpoG4WmBS93UDGo93UovbCjp0UC7sMf8JOltWe3RBl02n1m75FiJWfsHovNwdon7mUuc-jb2Dd0SuV3OqOAMzgWnoURVO3fWrqAuZy8byogjfvYssX36XMw-hFkGdRDw/4f2/LJ3QL1reR--QeBvbes0nYg/h2/h001.A1QqindjbecpKvAXAg0JO02N4VaPoipgHrU9_06SacU)
---
As of last year, more than 50 members of Congress owned stock in military contractors.3 It’s shameful that my colleagues continue to funnel billions of U.S. tax dollars to get rich from military contractor profits while voting to pass more funding to bomb people. This is corruption and cruelty; our elected officials should not be able to profit off of death.
If passed, the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_ will prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from having any financial interests in corporations that do business with the U.S. Department of Defense—including banning members from trading defense stocks.
The Executive Director of Win Without War said: _“Representative Tlaib’s bill is a vital step to breaking this cycle of war profiteering. If our leaders truly serve the public, they must put people over profits—not cash in on the wars they help wage.”_
Most Secretaries of Defense come directly from the weapons industry, which has spent over $260 million on lobbying and $56 million in direct campaign donations between 2022 and 2024. The organization Corporate Accountability explains: _“The [weapons] industry employed 858 lobbyists in 2022—more than one for every member of Congress.”_ 4
Unfortunately, the weapons industry exerts incredible influence not just in our political system, but also in our education system. Many U.S. universities have boards of trustees that include military corporations’ executives, who have been pressuring schools to crack down on campus speech and suppress anti-war student efforts while the Trump administration is simultaneously deporting student protesters without cause or due process.
**We can’t let our institutions prioritize the profits of military corporations over people’s needs.** I’ve instead pushed for giving direct cash assistance to people and ending childhood poverty in the United States. State Senator Nina Turner and I wrote: “ _In a country that wastes trillions of dollars on war while continuing to defund our social safety net, we know that poverty is a policy choice.”_
Instead of spending more on war than any other country in the world, we need to fund universal healthcare, housing for all, clean drinking water, school meals, childcare, and more.

clean_body: | | | Friend, With U.S. weapons, the Israeli military has violated the temporary ceasefire in Gaza. On March 18 Amnesty International’s Secretary General said, “Israel brazenly resumed its devastating bombing campaign in Gaza killing at least 414 people in their sleep” in one night, including more than 170 children.1 Additionally, the Trump administration bombed Yemen, killing children and other civilians in one of the most impoverished countries in the world. Since October 2023, our government has sent over $18 billion to fund the ethnic cleansing and extermination of Palestinians. Each year, most of my colleagues in Congress also vote to pass yet another record-breaking military budget. Even though the Pentagon has failed to pass an audit for 7 years in a row, last year the Pentagon budget was $895 billion, nearly $1 trillion taxpayer dollars. And now, congressional Republicans are attempting to add another $150 billion to the Pentagon budget and $175 billion to the Department of Homeland Security to help carry out Donald Trump’s cruel and illegal mass deportations. Republicans are trying to cut hundreds of billions of dollars from essential programs that millions of Americans rely on, including Medicaid and food stamps... while adding hundreds of billions of our taxpayer dollars to the military budget. This is** impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Why do we always have money for war, but not enough to feed the poor, as Tupac Shakur wrote decades ago? Part of the problem is the deep ties between lawmakers and the weapons industry. Half of the annual military budget lines the pockets of military contractors that profit off of mass death. Now, many of these contracting corporations have proposed taking over mass detentions and deportations, as well.2 Weapons corporations like Raytheon, Boeing, and Lockheed Martin spend millions to re-elect Congresspeople who serve on committees that determine military funding. Additionally, many members of Congress and their spouses invest directly in weapons contractor stocks, so when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally. Across political party lines, too many of my fellow Congresspeople are incentivized to push for military aggression rather than diplomacy. To stop this, I introduced the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act. | As of last year, more than 50 members of Congress owned stock in military contractors.3 It’s shameful that my colleagues continue to funnel billions of U.S. tax dollars to get rich from military contractor profits while voting to pass more funding to bomb people. This is corruption and cruelty; our elected officials should not be able to profit off of death. If passed, the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act will prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from having any financial interests in corporations that do business with the U.S. Department of Defense—including banning members from trading defense stocks. The Executive Director of Win Without War said: “Representative Tlaib’s bill is a vital step to breaking this cycle of war profiteering. If our leaders truly serve the public, they must put people over profits—not cash in on the wars they help wage.” Most Secretaries of Defense come directly from the weapons industry, which has spent over $260 million on lobbying and $56 million in direct campaign donations between 2022 and 2024. The organization Corporate Accountability explains: “The [weapons] industry employed 858 lobbyists in 2022—more than one for every member of Congress.” 4 Unfortunately, the weapons industry exerts incredible influence not just in our political system, but also in our education system. Many U.S. universities have boards of trustees that include military corporations’ executives, who have been pressuring schools to crack down on campus speech and suppress anti-war student efforts while the Trump administration is simultaneously deporting student protesters without cause or due process. We can’t let our institutions prioritize the profits of military corporations over people’s needs. I’ve instead pushed for giving direct cash assistance to people and ending childhood poverty in the United States. State Senator Nina Turner and I wrote: “ In a country that wastes trillions of dollars on war while continuing to defund our social safety net, we know that poverty is a policy choice.” Instead of spending more on war than any other country in the world, we need to fund universal healthcare, housing for all, clean drinking water, school meals, childcare, and more. Thank you for continuing to demand better from our government. I will continue to fight like hell to rein in military spending and corporate greed, invest in working families, and work toward a future that values diplomacy and peace over the military-industrial complex. Together, we will take steps toward the long-overdue dismantling of our country’s military-industrial complex, so that we can finally put a stop to forever wars and reinvest our tax dollars into providing our communities with the resources they need and deserve. name: Pete Maysmith, LCV
subject: I’m thrilled to be LCV’s new president, Peter
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIyODUwMjkS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE4MDM2OTUzNgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Hello Peter, Last week, Gene emailed you introducing me as the new president of the League of
Conservation Voters. I am enormously excited to take on this new role. LCV and
the Conservation Voters Movement have been my professional home for nearly 16
years. I’m so proud of what we’ve built, and what we’re going to continue to
build together. Still, I have no illusions about starting my new role during a time when so much
of what we’ve worked for — climate action, environmental justice, a strong
democracy — is in peril. Our climate progress is in jeopardy, the very idea of
being able to tackle racial inequality is at substantial risk, and democratic
institutions are under assault, even in danger of buckling. That’s why it’s more important than ever that LCV has your support, Peter. We need to grow our movement, share our vision for a safer, healthier future for all, and combat the chaos and harm caused by Trump, his billionaire friends, and extreme members of Congress. Please, give today. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ LCV builds political power to secure strong, long-lasting climate and democracy
policies. In this moment, we need to use that power to push back against the
Trump administration, his MAGA allies like Elon Musk, and those running
Congress. The way we succeed is through having supporters like you all across
the country that care about tackling the climate crisis, care about our
democracy, and stand with us. Our organization is smart and strategic, and, most importantly, we have the
support of people like you. Your generosity and commitment allows us to reach
people directly so that they can make the connection between the impacts of
climate and democracy polices and their daily lives. My priority as LCV president is to fight back against all attempts to pollute
our air and water and against efforts to weaken or dismantle our democracy. But I need you with me. In Trump’s first term, LCV was able to stop some of the worst attacks on the environment. We stopped pipelines. We saved public lands. We advanced clean energy. We were successful because of supporters like you. Give today so we can win again. https://links.messages.lcv. I bring a fierce commitment to LCV, the Conservation Voters Movement, and to
winning on climate and democracy. I’m eager to work with you on LCV’s plans for
how we succeed during this unprecedented time, and I promise to show up for this
movement, every day. I can’t wait to get started — and I hope you’ll join us. Each and every day, we go toe-to-toe with MAGA Republicans and corporate
polluters’ army of lobbyists — and we win, thanks to support from LCV’s members
like you. Thank you for being with us, and to quote Gene, Onward, Pete Maysmith

Donald Trump has officially weighed in on the Wisconsin Supreme Court race—and no surprise, he’s gone all in for Brad Schimel.

From redistricting and voting rights to abortion access and union protections, this court will be the final word. And if Schimel wins, conservatives will control it until at least 2026.

At GOTV PAC, we’re not letting billionaires and strongmen buy the court. We’re turning out voters the right way—with real conversations, peer-to-peer outreach, and one of the country's most effective paid phone and text banking operations.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Impacts to Social Security, Medicaid, and the VA
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
If you’re reading these emails, chances are you’re paying a lot more attention to this stuff than your friends and family are. You’re probably really fired up, too. That’s a good thing — more people should be as fired up as you are.
#

Friend —
I think most of you know that Elon Musk, his slash-and-burn campaign, and the Trump White House are trying to force through more than a trillion dollars in tax breaks for the richest people and most profitable corporations in the country.
And if you know that, you likely also know that they’re making room for those tax breaks by cutting the programs and services that you, your loved ones, or your friends depend on. Deleting the Department of Education, for one. Hundreds of billions cut from Medicaid. Closed offices, slashed staff, and reduced funding at Social Security. Thousands fired, impacting lifesaving programs the VA provides.
Now, I’ve got to touch base with you on this, because it’s important. If you’re reading these emails, chances are you’re paying a lot more attention to this stuff than your friends and family are. You’re probably really fired up, too. That’s a good thing — more people should be as fired up as you are.
But the truth is, this is a special group. And the harder truth is, a lot of people haven’t heard what Trump and Elon are doing. They’re busy with their own lives, raising their kids, trying to get bills paid. That’s not a criticism, and I mean that. It’s hard enough just getting by. But if we’re going to stop Elon and Trump from carrying out the worst that they’re trying to do, we’ve got to get those folks on board.
That’s what I’m trying to do right now. The work I’m doing, my social media, interviews I do in the news, my conversations with people in Arizona, the travel we’ll be doing to support the next generation of democratic candidates — we’re trying to get this stuff to break through.
Believe it or not, none of that comes easy, or cheap. It’s a lot of work, and it might surprise you to learn that we’re not a very big team. So, the donations we get from emails like this are a big help — they’re the primary way we cover the cost of the work we’re doing.
They mean a lot to me. Really. It’s humbling to have the support of people like you. But it also means that I have to ask, from time to time. And today is one of those days.
[**So, respectfully: Can you chip in $3 to help us keep up the fight?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-mar25.qCIGIs&refcode=em250324-1-90&t=1&akid=6014%2E6688874%2ECNtDi2)

Deleting the Department of Education, for one. Hundreds of billions cut from Medicaid. Closed offices, slashed staff, and reduced funding at Social Security. Thousands fired, impacting lifesaving programs the VA provides. Now, I’ve got to touch base with you on this, because it’s important. If you’re reading these emails, chances are you’re paying a lot more attention to this stuff than your friends and family are. You’re probably really fired up, too. That’s a good thing — more people should be as fired up as you are. But the truth is, this is a special group. And the harder truth is, a lot of people haven’t heard what Trump and Elon are doing. They’re busy with their own lives, raising their kids, trying to get bills paid. That’s not a criticism, and I mean that. It’s hard enough just getting by. But if we’re going to stop Elon and Trump from carrying out the worst that they’re trying to do, we’ve got to get those folks on board. That’s what I’m trying to do right now. The work I’m doing, my social media, interviews I do in the news, my conversations with people in Arizona, the travel we’ll be doing to support the next generation of democratic candidates — we’re trying to get this stuff to break through. Believe it or not, none of that comes easy, or cheap. It’s a lot of work, and it might surprise you to learn that we’re not a very big team. So, the donations we get from emails like this are a big help — they’re the primary way we cover the cost of the work we’re doing. They mean a lot to me. Really. It’s humbling to have the support of people like you. But it also means that I have to ask, from time to time. And today is one of those days. If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly: | | ** | | | | | | | ** Thanks so much. Mark Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate

As a result of our lawsuits, **federal courts temporarily blocked Trump’s mass firing of federal probationary employees and stopped him from gutting grants that train aspiring K-12 teachers and get more teachers into our schools.**
The federal workers Trump tried to fire and the teacher preparation grants he attempted to cancel provide support and services to countless Californians across our state— _we won’t sit idly by and allow him to break the law and threaten our workers, educators, and families._
While these two rulings are a step in the right direction, we know the fight isn’t over. These cases will continue through the court system, and we can expect more unconstitutional executive orders and other actions from this administration, which seems to think the rules don’t apply to them.

Last week we successfully blocked the Trump administration on two critical fronts, holding the President accountable to the law. As a result of our lawsuits, federal courts temporarily blocked Trump’s mass firing of federal probationary employees and stopped him from gutting grants that train aspiring K-12 teachers and get more teachers into our schools. The federal workers Trump tried to fire and the teacher preparation grants he attempted to cancel provide support and services to countless Californians across our state— we won’t sit idly by and allow him to break the law and threaten our workers, educators, and families. While these two rulings are a step in the right direction, we know the fight isn’t over. These cases will continue through the court system, and we can expect more unconstitutional executive orders and other actions from this administration, which seems to think the rules don’t apply to them. I’m not in this to stop one president or one agenda — I’m here to defend the rights and freedoms afforded to every Californian and to ensure everyone in our state can pursue their California Dream. In solidarity, Rob Bonta

body:
Barack Obama’s revolution| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=78866e4b7ac145b19ecd72d8be991b54&_e=0UOHPzfRsvwAdfFCK2zG5o6gtCxQjwdPwOwvBdPYOababUZ5x7sJyi_Poz6y6h671IJV2k8_w2v01PWSUa2tZEtO_wfw-KsTMcXHd7mPBZs8BbYaYh0EgNKqHBQcwz-VZpykOLDLtL-kMmTHdJ5eNLk3fsIJl0O6BdEUpZhHCF9fXJHzSiXku_tslJMPghomUgD25NAOCQNHyXA_4ese1ezGmwaD4r9JIZ38stc_XrKueTFhvAus2SkKIHcSy5fi7mn-gAFuvdKTB4L5xN1rP8_NtUBRzho0XmWMiaL3hUAU-3RF_ARTl_amHWczCWwxlgq0Qt1zQ0XAkxuVyNU106-TKyx_OL1lN8Pbz56C3hxkYPryapul-JSBpbygbThTTn57hmM_UvoLGWaSdPROcHD59J2rhbmqQXBhJZjLJRY%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=78866e4b7ac145b19ecd72d8be991b54&_e=0UOHPzfRsvwAdfFCK2zG5o6gtCxQjwdPwOwvBdPYOababUZ5x7sJyi_Poz6y6h671IJV2k8_w2v01PWSUa2tZEtO_wfw-KsTMcXHd7mPBZs8BbYaYh0EgNKqHBQcwz-VZpykOLDLtL-kMmTHdJ5eNLk3fsIJl0O6BdEUpZhHCF9fXJHzSiXku_tslJMPghomUgD25NAOCQNHyXA_4ese1ezGmwaD4r9JIZ38stc_XrKueTFhvAus2SkKIHcSy5fi7mn-gAFuvdKTB4L5xN1rP1bBc1y8xb1SgPpa0rVwCEoywMVM9UBw6Uo5HHsMDjD-G76j4w6g5XUSLih_0Huof0Z9SYkjAZ_FEf9gVkupSqnGXFZZLX_Kk0Sx2_EKeh3NzA75QRCUJDsqThhGA70BXIEXsVt9_a4I34e9bYJ_6vQ%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
